shlokas.sanskrit_text:
śrīrastu
bharatamunipraṇītaṃ nāṭyaśāstram
atha prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ
praṇamya śirasā devau pitāmahamaheśvarau /
nāṭyaśāstraṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇā yadudāhṛtam

samāptajapyaṃ vratinaṃ svasutaiḥ parivāritam /
anadhyāye kadācittu bharataṃ nāṭyakovidam

munayaḥ paryupāsyainamātreyapramukhāḥ purā /
papracchuste mahātmāno niyatendriyabuddhayaḥ

yo 'yaṃ bhagavatā samyaggrathito vedasammitaḥ /
nāṭyavedaṃ kathaṃ brahmannutpannaḥ kasya vā kṛte

katyaṅgaḥ kiṃpramāṇaśca prayogaścāsya kīdṛśaḥ /
sarvametadyathātattvaṃ bhagavanvaktumarhasi

teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā munīnāṃ bharato muniḥ /
pratyuvāca tato vākyaṃ nāṭyavedakathāṃ prati

bhavadbhiḥ śucibhirbhūtvā tathā'vahitamānasaiḥ /
śrūyatāṃ nāṭyavedasya sambhavo brahmanirmitaḥ

pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge viprā vṛtte svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare /
tretāyuge 'tha samprāpte manorvaivasvatasya tu

grāmyadharmapravṛtte tu kāmalobhavaśaṃ gate /
īrṣyākrodhādisaṃmūḍhe loke sukhitaduḥkhite

devadānavagandharvayakṣarakṣomahoragaiḥ /
jambudvīpe samākrānte lokapālapratiṣṭhite

mahendrapramukhairdevairuktaḥ kila pitāmahaḥ /
krīḍanīyakamicchāmo dṛṣyaṃ śravyaṃ ca yadbhavet

na vedavyavahāro 'yaṃ saṃśrāvyaḥ śūdrajātiṣu /
tasmātsṛjāparaṃ vedaṃ pañcamaṃ sārvavarṇikam

evamastviti tānuktvā devarājaṃ visṛjya ca /
sasmāra caturo vedānyogamāsthāya tattvavit

neme vedā yataḥ śrāvyāḥ strīśūdrādyāsu jātiṣu /
vedamanyattataḥ srakṣye sarvaśrāvyaṃ tu pañcamam

* dharmyamarthyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca sopadeśyaṃ sasaṅgraham /
bhaviṣyataśca lokasya sarvakarmānudarśakam

sarvaśātrārthasampannaṃ sarvaśilpapravartakam /
nāṭyākhyaṃ pañcamaṃ vedaṃ setihāsaṃ karomyaham

evaṃ saṅkalpya bhagavān sarvavedānanusmaran /
nāṭyavedaṃ tataścakre caturvedāṅgasambhavam

jagrāha pāṭhyamṛgvedātsāmabhyo gītameva ca /
yajurvedādabhinayān rasānātharvaṇādapi

vedopavedaiḥ sambaddho nāṭyavedo mahātmanā /
evaṃ bhagavatā sṛṣṭo brahmaṇā sarvavedinā

utpādya nāṭyavedaṃ tu brahmovāca sureśvaram /
itihāso mayā sṛṣṭaḥ sa sureṣu niyujyatām

kuśalā ye vidagdhāśca pragalbhāśca jitaśramāḥ /
teṣvayaṃ nāṭyasaṃjño hi vedaḥ saṃkrāmyatāṃ tvayā

tacchṛtvā vacanaṃ śakro brahmaṇā yadudāhṛtam /
prāñjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā pratyuvāca pitāmaham

grahaṇe dhāraṇe jñāne prayoge cāsya sattama /
aśaktā bhagavan devā ayogyā nāṭyakarmaṇi

ya ime vedaguhyajñā ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ /
ete 'sya grahaṇe śaktāḥ prayoge dhāraṇe tathā

śrutvā tu śakravacanaṃ māmāhāmbujasambhavaḥ /
tvaṃ putraśatasaṃyuktaḥ prayoktā'sya bhavānagha

ājñāpito viditvā'haṃ nāṭyavedaṃ pitāmahāt /
putrānadhyāpayāmāsa prayogaṃ cāpi tattvataḥ

śāṇḍilyaṃ caiva vātsyaṃ ca kohalaṃ dattilaṃ tathā /
jaṭilambaṣṭakau caiva taṇḍumagniśikhaṃ tathā

saindhavaṃ sapulomānaṃ śāḍvaliṃ vipulaṃ tathā /
kapiñjaliṃ vādiraṃ ca yamadhūmrāyaṇau tathā

jambudhvajaṃ kākajaṅghaṃ svarṇakaṃ tāpasaṃ tathā /
kaidāriṃ śālikarṇaṃ ca dīrghagātraṃ ca śālikam

kautsaṃ tāṇḍāyaniṃ caiva piṅgalaṃ citrakaṃ tathā /
bandhulaṃ bhallakaṃ caiva muṣṭhikaṃ saindhavāyanam

taitilaṃ bhārgavaṃ caiva śuciṃ bahulameva ca /
abudhaṃ budhasenaṃ ca pāṇḍukarṇaṃ sukeralam

ṛjukaṃ maṇḍakaṃ caiva śambaraṃ vañjulaṃ tathā /
māgadhaṃ saralaṃ caiva kartāraṃ cogrameva ca

tuṣāraṃ pārṣadaṃ caiva gautamaṃ bādarāyaṇam /
viśālaṃ śabalaṃ caiva sunāmaṃ meṣameva ca

kāliyaṃ bhramaraṃ caiva tathā pīṭhamukhaṃ munim /
nakhakuṭṭāśmakuṭṭau ca ṣaṭpadaṃ sottamaṃ tathā

pādukopānahau caiva śrutiṃ cāṣasvaraṃ tathā /
agnikuṇḍājyakuṇḍau ca vitaṇḍya tāṇḍyameva ca

kartarākṣaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ kuśalaṃ dussahaṃ tathā /
lājaṃ bhayānakaṃ caiva bībhatsaṃ savicakṣaṇam

puṇḍrākṣaṃ puṇḍranāsaṃ cāpyasitaṃ sitameva ca /
vidyujjihvaṃ mahājihvaṃ śālaṅkāyanameva ca

śyāmāyanaṃ māṭharaṃ ca lohitāṅgaṃ tathaiva ca /
saṃvartakaṃ pañcaśikhaṃ triśikhaṃ śikhameva ca

śaṅkhavarṇamukhaṃ śaṇḍaṃ śaṅkukarṇamathāpi ca /
śakranemiṃ gabhastiṃ cāpyaṃśumāliṃ śaṭhaṃ tathā

vidyutaṃ śātajaṅghaṃ ca raudraṃ vīramathāpi ca /
pitāmahājñayā'smābhirlokasya ca guṇepsayā

prayojitaṃ putraśataṃ yathābhūmivibhāgaśaḥ /
yo yasminkarmaṇi yathā yogyastasmin sa yojitaḥ

bhāratīṃ sātvatīṃ caiva vṛīttimārabhaṭīṃ tathā /
samāśritaḥ prayogastu prayukto vai mayā dvijāḥ

parigṛhya praṇamyātha brahmā vijñāpito mayā /
athāha māṃ suraguruḥ kaiśikimapi yojaya

yacca tasyāḥ kṣamaṃ dravyaṃ tad brūhi dvijasattama /
evaṃ tenāsmyabhihitaḥ pratyuktaśca mayā prabhuḥ

dīyatāṃ bhagavandravyaṃ kaiśikyāḥ samprayojakam /
nṛttāṅgahārasampannā rasabhāvakriyātmikā

dṛṣṭā mayā bhagavato nīlakaṇṭhasya nṛtyataḥ /
kaiśikī ṣlakṣṇanaipathyā śṛṅgārarasasambhavā

aśakyā puruṣaiḥ sā tu prayoktuṃ strījanādṛte /
tato 'sṛjanmahātejā manasā'psaraso vibhuḥ

nāṭyālaṅkāracaturāḥ prādānmahyaṃ prayogataḥ /
mañjukeśīṃ sukeśīṃ ca miśrakeśīṃ sulocanām

saudāminīṃ devadattāṃ devasenāṃ manoramām /
sudatīṃ sundarīṃ caiva vidagdhāṃ vipulāṃ tathā

sumālāṃ santatiṃ caiva sunandāṃ sumukhīṃ tathā /
māgadhīmarjunīṃ caiva saralāṃ keralāṃ dhṛtim

nandāṃ sapuṣkalāṃ caiva kalamāṃ caiva me dadau /
svātirbhāṇḍaniyuktastu saha śiṣyaiḥ svayambhuvā

nāradādyāśca gandharvā gānayoge niyojitāḥ /
evaṃ nāṭyamidaṃ samyagbuddhvā sarvaiḥ sutaiḥ saha

svātināradasaṃyukto vedavedāṅgakāraṇam /
upasthito 'haṃ brahmāṇaṃ prayogārthaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ

nāṭyasya grahaṇaṃ prāptaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇyaham /
etattu vacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca pitāmahaḥ

mahānayaṃ prayogasya samayaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ /
ayaṃ dhvajamahaḥ śrīmān mahendrasya pravartate

atredānīmayaṃ vedo nāṭyasaṃjñaḥ prayujyatām /
tatastasmindhvajamahe nihatāsuradānave

prahṛṣṭāmarasaṃkīrṇe mahendravijayotsave /
pūrvaṃ kṛtā mayā nāndī hyāśīrvacasaṃyutā

aṣṭāṅgapadasaṃyuktā vicitrā vedanirmitā /
tadante 'nukṛtirbaddhā yathā daityāḥ surairjitāḥ

sampheṭavidravakṛtā cchedyabhedyāhavālmikā /
tato brahmādayo devāḥ prayogaparitoṣitāḥ

pradadurmatsutebhyastu sarvopakaraṇāni vai /
prītastu prathamaṃ śakro dattavānsvaṃ dhvajaṃ śubham

brahmā kuṭilakaṃ caiva bhṛṅgāraṃ varuṇaḥ śubham /
sūryaśchatraṃ śivassiddhiṃ vāyurvyajanameva ca

viṣṇuḥ siṃhāsanaṃ caiva kubero mukuṭaṃ tathā /
śrāvyatvaṃ prekṣaṇīyasya dadau devī sarasvatī

śeṣā ye devagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ /
tasminsadasyabhipretānnānājātiguṇāśrayān

aṃśāṃśairbhāṣitaṃ bhāvān rasān rūpaṃ balaṃ tathā /
dattavantaḥ prahṛṣṭāste matsutebhyo divaukasaḥ

evaṃ prayoge prārabdhe daityadānavanāśane /
abhavankṣubhitāḥ sarve daityā ye tatra saṅgatāḥ

virūpākṣa purogāṃśca vighnānprotsāhya te 'bruvan /
na kṣamiṣyāmahe nāṭyametadāgamyatāmiti

tatastairasuraiḥ sārdhaṃ vighnā māyāmupāśritāḥ /
vācaśceṣṭāṃ smṛtiṃ caiva stambhayanti sma nṛtyatām

tathā vidhvaṃsanaṃ dṛṣṭvā sūtradhārasya devarāṭ /
kasmātprayogavaiṣamyamityuktvā dhyānamāviśat

athāpaśyatsado vighnaiḥ samantādparivāritam /
sahetaraiḥ sūtradhāraṃ naṣṭasaṃjñaṃ jaḍīkṛtam

utthāya tvaritaṃ śakraṃ gṛhītvā dhvajamuttamam /
sarvaratnojjvalatanuḥ kiñcidudvṛta locanaḥ

raṅgapīṭhagatānvighnānasurāṃścaiva devarāṭ /
jarjarīkṛtadehāṃstānakarojjarjareṇa saḥ

nihateṣu ca sarveṣua vighneṣu saha dānavaiḥ /
saṃprahṛṣya tato vākyamāhuḥ sarve divaukasaḥ

aho praharaṇaṃ divyamidamāsāditaṃ tvayā /
jarjarīkṛtasarvāṅgā yenaite dānavāḥ kṛtāḥ

yasmādanena te vighnāḥ sāsurā jarjarīkṛtāḥ /
tasmājjarjara eveti nāmato 'yaṃ bhaviṣyati

śeṣā ye caiva hiṃsārthamupayāsyanti hiṃsakāḥ /
dṛṣṭvaiva jarjaraṃ te 'pi gamiṣyantyevameva tu

evamevāstviti tataḥ śakraḥ provāca tānsurān /
rakṣābhūtaśca sarveṣāṃ bhaviṣyatyeṣa jarjaraḥ

prayoge prastute hyevaṃ sphīte śakramahe punaḥ /
trāsaṃ sañjanayanti sma vighnāḥ śeṣāstu nṛtyatām

dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ vyavasitaṃ daityānāṃ viprakārajam /
upasthito 'haṃ brahmāṇaṃ sutaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ

niścitā bhagavanvighnā nāṭyasyāsya vināśane /
asya rakṣāvidhiṃ samyagājñāpaya sureśvara

tataśca viśvakarmāṇaṃ brahmovāca prayatnataḥ /
kuru lakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ nāṭyaveśma mahāmate

tato 'cireṇa kālena viśvakarmā mahacchubham /
sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ kṛtvā nāṭyagṛhaṃ tu saḥ

proktavāndruhiṇaṃ gatvā sabhāyāntu kṛtāñjalīḥ /
sajjaṃ nāṭyagṛhaṃ deva tadevekṣitumarhasi

tataḥ saha mahendreṇa suraiḥ sarvaiśca setaraiḥ /
āgatastvarito dṛṣṭuṃ druhiṇo nāṭyamaṇḍapam

dṛṣṭvā nāṭyagṛhaṃ brahmā prāha sarvānsurāṃstataḥ /
aṃśabhāgairbhavadbhistu rakṣyo 'yaṃ nāṭyamaṇḍapaḥ

rakṣaṇe maṇḍapasyātha viniyuktastu candramāḥ /
lokapālāstathā dikṣu vidikṣvapi ca mārutāḥ

nepathyabhūmau mitrastu nikṣipto varuṇo 'mbare /
vedikārakṣaṇe vahnirbhāṇḍe sarvadivaukasaḥ

varṇāścatvāra evātha stambheṣu viniyojitāḥ /
ādityāścaiva rudrāśca sthitāḥ stambhāntareśvatha

dhāraṇīśvatha bhūtāni śālāsvapsarastathā /
sarvaveśmasu yakṣiṇyo mahīpṛṣṭhe mahodadhiḥ

dvāraśālāniyuktau tu krutāntaḥ kāla eva ca /
sthāpitau dvārapatreṣu nāgamukhyau mahābalau

dehalyāṃ yamadaṇḍastu śūlaṃ tasyopari sthitam /
dvārapālau sthitau caubhau niyatirmṛtyureva ca

pārśve ca raṅgapīṭhasya mahendraḥ sthitavānsvayam /
sthāpitā mattavāraṇyāṃ vidyuddaityaniṣūdanī

stambheṣu mattavāraṇyāḥ sthāpitā paripālane /
bhūtayakṣapiśāśca guhyakāśca mahābalāḥ

jarjare tu vinikṣiptaṃ vajraṃ daityanibarhaṇam /
tatparvasu vinikṣiptāḥ surendrā hyamitaujasaḥ

śiraḥparvasthito brahmā dvitīye śaṅkarastathā /
tṛtīye ca sthito viṣṇuścaturthe skanda eva ca

pañcame ca mahānāgāḥ śeṣavāsukitakṣakāḥ /
evaṃ vighnavināśāya sthāpitā jarjare surāḥ

raṅgapīṭhasya madhye tu svayaṃ brahmā pratiṣṭhitaḥ /
iṣṭyarthaṃ raṅgamadhye tu kriyate puṣpamokṣaṇam

pātālavāsino ye ca yakṣaguhyakapannagāḥ /
adhastādraṅgapīṭhasya rakṣaṇe te niyojitāḥ

nāyakaṃ rakṣatīndrastu nāyikāṃ ca sarasvatī /
vidūṣakamathauṅkāraḥ śeśāstu prakṛtirharaḥ

yānyetāni niyuktāni daivatānīha rakṣaṇe /
etānyevādhidaivāni bhaviṣyantītyuvāca saḥ

etasminnantare devaiḥ sarvairuktaḥ pitāmahaḥ /
sāmnā tāvadime vighnāḥ sthāpyantāṃ vacasā tvayā

pūrvaṃ sāmaṃ prayoktavyaṃ dvitīyaṃ dānameva ca /
tayorupari bhedastu tato daṇḍaḥ prayujyate

devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā vighnānuvāca ha /
kasmādbhavanto nāṭyasya vināśāya samutthitāḥ

brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā virūpākṣo 'bravīdvacaḥ /
daityairvighnagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sāmapūrvamidaṃ tataḥ

yo 'yaṃ bhagavatā sṛṣṭo nāṭyavedaḥ surecchayā /
pratyādeśo 'yamasmākaṃ surārthaṃ bhavatā kṛtaḥ

tannaitadevaṃ kartavyaṃ tvayā lokapitāmaha /
yathā devastathā daityāstvattaḥ sarve vinirgatāḥ

vighnānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā vacanamabravīt /
alaṃ vo manyunā daityā viṣādaṃ tyajatānaghāḥ

bhavatāṃ devatānāṃ ca śubhāśubhavikalpakaḥ /
karmabhāvānvayāpekṣī nāṭyavedo mayā kṛtaḥ

naikāntato 'tra bhavatāṃ devānāṃ cānubhāvanam /
trailokyāsyāsya sarvasya nāṭyaṃ bhāvānukīrtanam

kvaciddharmaḥ kvacitkrīḍā kvacidarthaḥ kvacicchamaḥ /
kvaciddhāsyaṃ kvacidyuddhaṃ kvacitkāmaḥ kvacidvadhaḥ

dharmo dharmapravṛttānāṃ kāmaḥ kāmopasevinām /
nigraho durvinītānāṃ vinītānāṃ damakriyā

klībānāṃ dhārṣṭyajananamutsāhaḥ śūramāninām /
abudhānāṃ vibodhaśca vaiduṣyaṃ viduṣāmapi

īśvarāṇāṃ vilāsaśca sthairyaṃ duḥkhārditasya ca /
arthopajīvināmartho dhṛtirudvegacetasām

nānābhāvopasampannaṃ nānāvasthāntarātmakam /
lokavṛttānukaraṇaṃ nāṭyametanmayā kṛtam

uttamādhamamadhyānāṃ narāṇāṃ karmasaṃśrayam /
hitopadeśajananaṃ dhṛtikrīḍāsukhādikṛt

etadraseṣu bhāveṣu sarvakarmakriyāsvatha /
sarvopadeśajananaṃ nāṭyaṃ loke bhaviṣyati

* duḥkhārtānāṃ śramārtānāṃ śokārtānāṃ tapasvinām /
viśrāntijananaṃ kāle nāṭyametadbhaviṣyati

dharmyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ hitaṃ buddhivivardhanam /
lokopadeśajananaṃ nāṭyametadbhaviṣyati

na tajjñānaṃ na tacchilpaṃ na sā vidyā na sā kalā /
nāsau yogo na tatkarma nāṭye 'smin yanna dṛśyate

tannātra manyuḥ kartavyo bhavadbhiramarānprati /
saptadvīpānukaraṇaṃ nāṭyametadbhaviṣyati
yenānukaraṇaṃ nāṭyametattadyanmayā kṛtam

* devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca rājñāmatha kuṭumbinām /
brahmarṣīṇāṃ ca vijñeyaṃ nāṭyaṃ vṛttāntadarśakam

yo 'yaṃ svabhāvo lokasya sukhaduḥkhasamanvitaḥ /
so 'ṅgādyabhinayopeto nāṭyamityabhidhīyate

vedavidyetihāsānāmākhyānaparikalpanam /
vinodakaraṇaṃ loke nāṭyametadbhaviṣyati

* śrutismṛtisadācārapariśeṣārthakalpanam /
vinodajananaṃ loke nāṭyametadbhaviṣyati

** etasminnantare devān sarvānāha pitāmahaḥ /
kriyatāmadya vidhivadyajanaṃ nāṭyamaṇḍape

balipradānairhomaiśca mantrauṣadhisamanvitaiḥ /
bhojyairbhakṣaiśca pānaiśca baliḥ samupakalpatām

martyalokagatāḥ sarve śubhāṃ pūjāmavāpsyatha /
apūjayitvā raṅgaṃ tu naiva prekṣāṃ pravartayet

apūjayitvā raṅgaṃ tu yaḥ prekṣāṃ kalpayiṣyati /
niṣphalaṃ tasya tat jñānaṃ tiryagyoniṃ ca yāsyati

yajñena saṃmitaṃ hyedadraṅgadaivatapūjanam /
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ nāṭyayoktṛbhiḥ

nartako 'rthapatirvāpi yaḥ pūjāṃ na kariṣyati /
na kārayiṣyantyanyairvā prāpnotyapacayaṃ tu saḥ

yathāvidhiṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ yastu pūjāṃ kariṣyati /
sa lapsyate śubhānarthān svargalokaṃ ca yāsyati

evamuktvā tu bhagavāndruhiṇaḥ sahadevataiḥ /
raṅgapūjāṃ kuruśveti māmevaṃ samacodayat

iti bhāratīye nāṭyaśāstre nāṭyotpattirnāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ
atha bhāratīye nāṭyaśāstre dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā papracchurmunayastataḥ /
bhagavan śrotumicchāmo yajanaṃ raṅgasaṃśrayam

atha vā yā kriyāstatra lakṣaṇaṃ yacca pūjanam /
bhaviṣyadbhirnaraiḥ kāryaṃ kathaṃ tannāṭyaveśmani

ihādirnāṭyayogasya nāṭyamaṇḍapa eva hi /
tasmāttasyaiva tāvattvaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vaktumarhasi

teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā munīnāṃ bharato 'bravīt /
lakṣaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ caiva śrūyatāṃ nāṭyaveśmanaḥ

divyānāṃ mānasī sṛṣṭirgṛheṣūpavaneṣu ca /
(yathā bhāvābhinirvartyāḥ sarve bhāvāstu mānuṣāḥ) /
narāṇāṃ yatnataḥ kāryā lakṣaṇābhihitā kriyā

śrūyatāṃ tadyathā yatra kartavyo nāṭyamaṇḍapaḥ /
tasya vāstu ca pūjā ca yathā yojyā prayatnataḥ

iha prekṣyāgṛhaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhīmatā viśvakarmaṇā /
trividhaḥ sanniveśaśca śāstrataḥ parikalpitaḥ

vikṛṣṭaścaturaśraśca tryaśraścaiva tu maṇḍapaḥ /
teṣāṃ trīṇi pramāṇāni jyeṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃ tathā'varam

pramāṇameṣāṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ hastadaṇḍasamāśrayam /
śataṃ cāṣṭau catuḥṣaṣṭirhastā dvātriṃśadeva ca

aṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭistu madhyamam /
kanīyastu tathā veśma hastā dvātriṃśadiṣyate

devānāṃ tu bhavejjyeṣṭhaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet /
śeṣāṇāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ tu kanīyaḥ saṃvidhīyate

prekṣāgṛhāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ praśastaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam /
tatra pāṭhyaṃ ca geyaṃ ca sukhaśrāvyataraṃ bhavet

* prekṣāgṛhāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ triprakāro vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
vikṛṣṭaścaturasraśca tryasraścaiva prayoktṛbhiḥ

** kanīyastu smṛtaṃ tryasraṃ caturasraṃ tu madhyamam /
jyeṣṭhaṃ vikṛṣṭaṃ vijñeyaṃ nāṭyavedaprayoktṛbhiḥ

*** pramāṇaṃ yacca nirdiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ viśvakarmaṇā /
prekṣāgṛhāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ taccaiva hi nibodhata

aṇū rajaśca vālaśca likṣā yūkā yavastathā /
aṅgulaṃ ca tathā hasto daṇḍaścaiva prakīrtitaḥ

aṇavo 'ṣṭau rajaḥ proktaṃ tānyaṣṭau vāla ucyate /
vālāstvaṣṭau bhavellikṣā yūkā likṣāṣṭakaṃ bhavet

yūkāstvaṣṭau yavo jñeyo yavāstvaṣṭau tathāṅgulam /
aṅgulāni tathā hastaścaturviṃśatirucyate

caturhasto bhaveddaṇḍo nirdiṣṭastu pramāṇataḥ /
anenaiva pramāṇena vakṣyāmyeṣāṃ vinirṇayam

catuḥṣaṣṭikarānkuryāddīrghatvena tu maṇḍapam /
dvātriṃśataṃ ca vistāranmartyānāṃ yo bhavediha

ata ūrdhvaṃ na kartavyaḥ kartṛbhirnāṭyamaṇḍapaḥ /
yasmādavyaktabhāvaṃ hi tatra nāṭyaṃ vrajediti

maṇḍape viprakṛṣṭe tu pāṭhyamuccāritasvaram /
anissaraṇadharmatvādvisvaratvaṃ bhṛśaṃ vrajet
sa veśmanaḥ prakṛṣṭatvād vrajedavyaktatāṃ parām

prekṣāgṛhāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ tasmānmadhyamamiṣyate /
yāvatpāṭhyaṃ ca geyaṃ ca tatra śravyataraṃ bhavet

prekṣāgṛhāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ triprakāro vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
vikṛṣṭaścaturasraśca tryasraścaiva prayoktṛbhiḥ

* kanīyastu smṛtaṃ tryasraṃ caturasraṃ tu madhyamam /
jyeṣṭhaṃ vikṛṣṭaṃ vijñeyaṃ nāṭyavedaprayoktṛbhiḥ

** devānāṃ mānasī sṛṣṭirgṛheṣūpavaneṣu ca /
yatnabhāvābhiniṣpannāḥ sarve bhāvā hi mānuṣā

tasmāddevakṛtairbhāvairna vispardheta mānuṣaḥ /
mānuṣasya tu gehasya sampravakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam

bhūmervibhāgaṃ pūrvaṃ tu parīkṣeta prayojaka /
tato vāstu pramāṇena prārabheta śubhecchayā

samā sthirā tu kaṭhinā kṛṣṇā gaurī ca yā bhavet /
bhūmistatraiva kartavyaḥ kartṛbhirnāṭyamaṇḍapaḥ

prathamaṃ śodhanaṃ kṛtvā lāṅgalena samutkṛṣet /
asthikīlakapālāni tṛṇagulmāṃśca śodhayet

śodhayitvā vasumatīṃ pramāṇaṃ nirdiśettataḥ /
(trīṇyuttarāṇi saumyaṃ ca viśākhāpi ca revatī /
hastitiṣyānurādhāśca praśastā nāṭyakarmaṇi) /
puṣyanakṣatrayogena śuklaṃ sūtraṃ prasārayet

kārpāsaṃ bālbajaṃ vāpi mauñjaṃ vālkalameva ca /
sūtraṃ budhaistu kartavyaṃ yasya cchedo na vidyate

ardhacchinne bhavetsūtre svāmino maraṇaṃ dhruvam /
tribhāgacchinnayā rajvā rāṣṭrakopo vidhīyate

chinnāyāṃ tu caturbhāge prayokturnāśa ucyate /
hastātprabhraṣṭayā vāpi kaścitvapacayo bhavet

tasmānnityaṃ prayatnena rajjugrahaṇamiṣyate /
kāryaṃ caiva prayatnena mānaṃ nāṭyagṛhasya tu

muhūrtenānukūlena tithyā sukaraṇena ca /
brāhmaṇāṃstarpayitvā tu puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ

śāntitoyaṃ tato dattvā tataḥ sūtraṃ prasārayet /
catuṣṣaṣṭikarānkṛtvā dvidhā kuryātpunaśca tān

pṛṣṭhato yo bhavedbhāgo dvidhābhūtasya tasya tu /
samamardhavibhāgena raṅgaśīrṣaṃ prakalpayet

paścime ca vibhāge 'tha nepathyagṛhamādiśet /
vibhajya bhāgānvidhivadyayathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ

śubhe nakṣatrayoge ca maṇḍapasya niveśanam /
śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣairmṛdaṅgapaṇavādibhiḥ

sarvātodyaiḥ praṇuditaiḥ sthāpanaṃ kāryameva tu /
utsāryāṇi tvaniṣṭāni pāṣaṇḍyāśramiṇastathā

kāṣāyavasanāścaiva vikalāścaiava ye narāḥ /
niśāyāṃ ca baliḥ kāryā nānābhojanasaṃyutaḥ

gandhapuṣpaphalopetā diśo daśa samāśritaḥ /
pūrveṇa śuklānnayuto nīlānno dakṣiṇena ca

paścimena baliḥ pīto raktaścaivottareṇa tu /
yādṛśaṃ diśi yasyāṃ tu daivataṃ parikalpitam

tādṛśastatra dātavyo balirmantrapuraskṛtaḥ /
sthāpane brāhmaṇebhyaśca dātavyaṃ ghṛtapāyasam

madhuparkastathā rājñe kartṛbhyaśca guḍaudanam /
nakṣatreṇa tu kartavyaṃ mūlena sthāpanaṃ budhaiḥ

muhūrtenānukūlena tithyā sukaraṇena ca /
evaṃ tu sthāpanaṃ kṛtvā bhittikarma prayojayet

bhittikarmaṇi nirvṛtte stambhānāṃ sthāpanaṃ tataḥ /
tithinakṣatrayogena śubhena karaṇena ca

stambhānāṃ sthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ rohiṇyā śravaṇena vā /
ācāryeṇa suyuktena trirātropoṣitena ca

stambhānāṃ sthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ prāpte sūryodaye śubhe /
prathame brāhmaṇastambhe sarpissarṣapasaṃskṛtaḥ

sarvaśuklo vidhiḥ kāryo dadyātpāyasameva ca /
tataśca kṣatriyastambhe vastramālyānulepanam

sarva raktaṃ pradātavyaṃ dvijebhyaśca guḍaudanam /
vaiśyastambhe vidhiḥ kāryo digbhāge paścimottare

sarvaṃ prītaṃ pradātavyaṃ dvijebhyaśca ghṛtaudanam /
śūdrastambhe vidhiḥ kāryaḥ samyakpūrvottarāśraye

nīlaprāyaṃ prayatnena kūsaraṃ ca dvijāśanam /
pūrvoktabrāhmaṇastambhe śuklamālyānulepane

nikṣipetkanakaṃ mūle karṇābharaṇasaṃśrayam /
tāmraṃ cādhaḥ pradātavyaṃ stambhe kṣatriyasaṃjñake

vaiśyastambhasya mūle tu rajataṃ sampradāpayet /
śūdrastambhasya mūle tu dadyādāyasameva ca

sarveṣveva tu nikṣepyaṃ stambhamūleṣu kāñcanam /
svastipuṇyāhaghoṣeṇa jayaśabdena caiva hi

stambhānāṃ sthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ puṣpamālāpuraskṛtam /
ratnadānaiḥ sagodānairvastradānairanalpakaiḥ

brāhmaṇāṃstarpayitvā tu stambhānutthāpayettataḥ /
acalaṃ cāpyakampañca tathaivāvalitaṃ punaḥ

stambhasyotthāpane samyagdoṣā hyete prakīrtitāḥ /
avṛṣṭiruktā calane valane mṛtyuto bhayam

kampane paracakrāttu bhayaṃ bhavati dāruṇam /
doṣairetairvihīnaṃ tu stambhamutthāpayecchivam

pavitre brāhmaṇastambhe dātavyā dakṣiṇā ca gauḥ /
śeṣāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ kāryaṃ sthāpane kartṛsaṃśrayam

mantrapūtaṃ ca taddeyaṃ nāṭyācāryeṇa dhīmatā /
purohitaṃ nṛpaṃ caiva bhojayenmadhupāyasaiḥ

kartṝnāpi tathā sarvānkṛsarāṃ lavaṇottarām /
sarvamevaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā sarvātodyaiḥ pravāditaiḥ

abhimantrya yathānyāyaṃ stambhānutthāpayecchuciḥ /
'yathā'calo girirmerurhimavāṃśca mahābalaḥ

jayāvaho narendrasya tathā tvamacalo bhava' /
stambhadvāraṃ ca bhittiṃ ca nepathyagṛhameva ca

evamutthāpayetajjño vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā /
raṅgapīṭhasya pārśve tu kartavyā mattavāraṇī

catustambhasamāyuktā raṅgapīṭhapramāṇataḥ /
adhyardhahastotsedhena kartavyā mattavāraṇī

utsedhena tayostulyaṃ kartavyaṃ raṅgamaṇḍapam /
tasyāṃ mālyaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca gandhaṃ vastraṃ tathaiva ca

nānāvarṇāni deyāni tathā bhūtapriyo baliḥ /
āyasaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ stambhānāṃ kuśailairadhaḥ

bhojane kṛsarāścaiva dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇāśanam /
evaṃ vidhipuraskāraiḥ kartavyā mattavāraṇī

raṅgapīṭhaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ vidhidṛṣṭeṇa karmaṇā /
raṅgaśīrṣastu kartavyaṃ ṣaḍdārukasamanvitam

kāryaṃ dvāradvayaṃ cātra nepathyagṛhakasya tu /
pūraṇe mṛttikā cātra kṛṣṇā deyā prayatnataḥ

lāṅgalena samutkṛṣya nirloṣṭatṛṇaśarkaram /
lāṅgale śuddhavarṇo tu dhuryo yojyau prayatnataḥ

kartāraḥ puruṣaścātra ye 'ṅgadoṣavivirjitāḥ /
ahīnāṅgaiśca voḍhavyā mṛttikā piṭakairnavaiḥ

evaṃvidhaiḥ prakartavyaṃ raṅgaśīrṣaṃ prayatnataḥ /
kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ na kartavyaṃ matsyapṛṣṭhaṃ tathaiva ca

śuddhādarśatalākāraṃ raṅgaśīrṣaṃ praśasyate /
ratnāni cātra deyāni pūrve vajraṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ

vaiḍūryaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve sphaṭikaṃ paścime tathā /
pravālamuttare caiva madhye tu kanakaṃ bhavet

evaṃ raṅgaśiraḥ kṛtvā dārukarma prayojayet /
ūhapratyūhasaṃyuktaḥ nānāśilpaprayojitam

nānāsañjavanopetaṃ bahuvyālopaśobhitam /
sasālabhañjikābhiśca samantātsamalaṅkṛtam

nirvyūhakuharopetaṃ nānāgrathitavedikam /
nānāvinyāsasaṃyuktaṃ citrajālagavākṣakam

supīṭhadhāriṇīyuktaṃ kapotālīsamākulam /
nānākuṭṭimavinyastaiḥ stambhaiścāpyupaśobhitam

evaṃ kāṣṭhavidhiṃ kṛtvā bhittikarma prayojayet /
stambhaṃ vā nāgadantaṃ vā vātāyanamathāpi vā

koṇaṃ vā sapratidvāraṃ dvāraviddhaṃ na kārayet /
kāryaḥ śailaguhākāro dvibhūmirnāṭyamaṇḍapaḥ

mandavātāyanopeto nirvāto dhīraśabdavān /
tasmānnivātaḥ kartavyaḥ kartṛbhirnāṭyamaṇḍapaḥ

gambhīrasvaratā yena kutapasya bhaviṣyati /
bhittikarmavidhiṃ kṛtvā bhittilepaṃ pradāpayet

sudhākarma bahistasya vidhātavyaṃ prayatnataḥ /
bhittiṣvatha viliptāsu parimṛṣṭāsu sarvataḥ

samāsu jātaśobhāsu citrakarma prayojayet /
citrakarmaṇi cālekhyāḥ puruṣāḥ srījanāstathā

latābandhāśca kartavyāścaritaṃ cātmbhogajam /
evaṃ vikṛṣṭaṃ kartavyaṃ nāṭyaveśma prayoktṛbhiḥ

punareva hi vakṣyāmi caturaśrasya lakṣaṇam /
samantataśca kartavyā hastā dvātriṃśadeva tu

śubhabhūmivibhāgastho nāṭyajñairnāṭyamaṇḍapaḥ /
yo vidhiḥ pūrvamuktastu lakṣaṇaṃ maṅgalāni ca

vikṛṣṭe tānyaśeṣāṇi caturaśre 'pi kārayet /
caturaśraṃ samaṃ kṛtvā sūtreṇa pravibhajya ca

bāhyataḥ sarvataḥ kāryā bhittiḥ śliṣṭeṣṭakā dṛḍhā /
tatrābhyantarataḥ kāryā raṅgapīṭhopari sthitāḥ

daśa prayoktṛbhiḥ stambhāḥ śaktā maṇḍapadhāraṇe /
stambhānāṃ bāhyataścāpi sopānākṛti pīṭhakam

iṣṭakādārubhiḥ kāryaṃ prekṣakāṇāṃ niveśanam /
hastapramāṇairutsedhairbhūmibhāgasamutthitaiḥ

raṅgapīṭhāvalokyaṃ tu kuryādāsanajaṃ vidhim /
ṣaḍanyānantare caiva punaḥ stambhānyathādiśam

vidhinā sthāpayetajño dṛḍhānmaṇḍapadhāraṇe /
aṣṭau stambhānpunaścaiva teṣāmupari kalpayet

sthāpyaṃ caiva tataḥ pīṭhamaṣṭahastapramāṇataḥ /
viddhāsyamaṣṭahastaṃ ca pīṭhaṃ teṣu tato nyaset

tatra stambhāḥ pradātavyāstajñairmaṇḍapadhāraṇe /
dhāraṇīdhāraṇāste ca śālastrībhiralaṅkṛtāḥ

nepathyagṛhakaṃ caiva tataḥ kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ /
dvāraṃ caikaṃ bhavettatra raṅgapīṭhapraveśanam

janapraveśanaṃ cānyadābhimukhyena kārayet /
raṅgasyābhimukhaṃ kāryaṃ dvitīyaṃ dvārameva tu

aṣṭahastaṃ tu kartavyaṃ raṅgapīṭhaṃ pramāṇataḥ /
caturaśraṃ samatalaṃ vedikāsamalaṅkṛtam

pūrvapramāṇanirdiṣṭā kartavyā mattavāraṇī /
catuḥstambhasamāyuktā vedikāyāstu pārśvataḥ

samunnataṃ samaṃ caiva raṅgaśīrṣaṃ tu kārayet /
vikṛṣṭe tūnnataṃ kāryaṃ caturaśre samaṃ tathā

evametena vidhinā caturaśraṃ gṛhaṃ bhavet /
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tryaśragehasya lakṣaṇam

tryaśraṃ trikoṇaṃ kartavyaṃ nāṭyaveśmaprayoktṛbhiḥ /
madhye trikoṇamevāsya raṅgapīṭhaṃ tu kārayet

dvāraṃ tainaiva koṇena kartavyaṃ tasya veśmanaḥ /
dvitīyaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ raṅgapīṭhasya pṛṣṭhataḥ

vidhiryaścaturaśrasya bhittistambhasamāśrayaḥ /
sa tu sarvaḥ prayoktavyastryaśrasyāpi prayoktṛbhiḥ

evametena vidhinā kāryā nāṭyagṛhā budhaiḥ /
punareṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi pūjāmevaṃ yathāvidhiḥ

iti bhāratīye nāṭyaśāstre maṇḍapavidhāno nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
atha tṛtīyodhyāyaḥ
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpanne kṛte nāṭyagṛhe śubhe /
gāvo vaseyuḥ saptāhaṃ saha japyaparairdvijaiḥ

tato 'dhivāsayedveśma raṅgapīṭhaṃ tathaiva ca /
mantrapūtena toyena prokṣitāṅgo niśāgame

yathāsthānāntaragato dīkṣitaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ /
trirātropoṣito bhūtvā nāṭyācāryo 'hatāmbaraḥ

namaskṛtya mahādevaṃ sarvalokodbhavaṃ bhavam /
jagatpitāmahaṃ caiva viṣṇumindraṃ guhaṃ tathā

sarasvatīṃ ca lakṣmīṃ ca siddhiṃ medhāṃ dhṛtiṃ smṛtim /
somaṃ sūryaṃ ca maruto lokapālāṃstathāśvinau

mitramagniṃ surānvarṇān rudrānkālaṃ kaliṃ tathā /
mṛtyuṃ ca niyatiṃ caiva kāladaṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca

viṣṇupraharaṇaṃ caiva nāgarājaṃ ca vāsukim /
vajraṃ vidyutsamudrāṃśca gandharvāpsaraso munīn

bhūtān piśācān yakṣāṃśca guhyakāṃśca maheśvarān /
asurānnāṭyavighnāṃśca tathā'nyāndaityarākṣasān

tathā nāṭyakumārīśca mahāgrāmaṇyameva ca /
yakṣāṃśca guhyakāṃścaiva bhūtasaṅghāstathaiva ca

etāṃścānyāṃśca devarṣīnpraṇamya racitāñjaliḥ /
yathāsthānāntaragatānsamāvāhya tato vadet

bhavadbhirno niśāyāṃ tu kartavyaḥ samparigrahaḥ /
sāhāyyaṃ caiva dātavyamasminnāṭye sahānugaiḥ

sampūjya sarvānekatra kutapaṃ samprayujya ca /
jarjarāya prayuñjīta pūjāṃ nāṭyaprasiddhaye

tvaṃ mahendrapraharaṇaṃ sarvadānavasūdanam /
nirmitassarvadevaiśca sarvavighnanibarhaṇa

nṛpasya vijayaṃ śaṃsa ripūṇāṃ ca parājayam /
gobrāhmaṇaśivaṃ caiva nāṭyasya ca vivardhanam

evaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyamupāsyaṃ nāṭyamaṇḍape /
niśāyāṃ tu prabhātāyāṃ pūjanaṃ prakramediha

ārdrāyāṃ vā maghāyāṃ vā yāmye pūrveṣu vā triṣu /
āśleṣāmūlayorvāpi kartavyaṃ raṅgapūjanam

ācāryeṇa tu yuktena śucinā dīkṣitena ca /
raṅgasyodyotanaṃ kāryaṃ devatānāṃ ca pūjanam

dinānte dāruṇe ghore muhūrte yamadaivate /
ācamya tu yathānyāyaṃ devatā vai niveśayat

raktāḥ pratisarāḥ sūtraṃ raktagandhāśca pūjitāḥ /
raktāḥ sumanasaścaiva yacca raktaṃ phalaṃ bhavet

yavaissiddhārthakairlājairakṣataiḥ śālitaṇḍulaiḥ /
nāgapuṣpasya cūrṇena vituṣābhiḥ priyaṅgubhiḥ

etairdravyairyutaṃ kuryāddevatānāṃ niveśanam /
ālikhenmaṇḍalaṃ pūrvaṃ yathāsthānaṃ yathāvidhiḥ

samantastaśca kartavyaṃ hastā ṣoḍaśa maṇḍalam /
dvārāṇi cātra kurvīta vidhānena caturdiśam

madhye caivātra kartavye dve rekhe tiryagūrdhvage /
tayoḥ kakṣyāvibhāgena daivatāni niveśayat

padmopaviṣṭaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tasya madhye niveśayet /
ādau niveśyo bhagavānsārdhaṃ bhūtagaṇaiḥ śivaḥ

nārāyaṇo mahendraśca skandaḥ sūryo 'śvinau śaśī /
sarasvatī ca lakṣmīśca śraddhā medhā ca pūrvataḥ

pūrvadakṣiṇato vahnirniveśyaḥ svāhayā saha /
viśvedevāḥ sagandharvā rudrāḥ sarpagaṇāstathā

dakṣiṇena niveśyastu yamo mitraśca sānugaḥ /
pitṝnpiśācānuragān guhyakāṃśca niveśayat

naiṝtyāṃ rākṣasāṃścaiva bhūtāni ca niveśayat /
paścimāyāṃ samudrāṃśca varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patim

vāyavyāyāṃ diśi tathā sapta vāyūnniveśayet /
tatraiva viniveśyastu garuḍaḥ pakṣibhiḥ saha

uttarasyāṃ diśi tathā dhanadaṃ saṃnivieśayet /
nāṭyasya mātṝśca tathā yakṣānatha saguhyakān

tathaivottarapūrvāyāṃ nandyādyāṃśca gaṇeśvarān /
brahmarṣibhūtasaṃghāṃśca yathābhāgaṃ niveśayat

stambhe sanatkumāraṃ tu dakṣiṇe dakṣameva ca /
grāmaṇyamuttare stambhe pūjārthaṃ saṃniviśayet

anenaiava vidhānena yathāsthānaṃ yathāvidhi /
suprasādāni sarvāṇi daivatāni niveśayat

sthāne sthāne yathānyāyaṃ viniveśya tu devatāḥ /
tāsāṃ prakurvīta tataḥ pūjanaṃ tu yathārhataḥ

devatābhyastu dātavyaṃ sitamālyānulepanam /
gandharvavahnisūryobhyo raktamālyānulepanam

gandhaṃ mālyaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ /
datvā tataḥ prakurvīta baliṃ pūjāṃ yathāvidhiḥ

brahmāṇaṃ madukarpeṇa pāyasena sarasvatīm /
śivaviṣṇumahendrādyāḥ sampūjyā modakairatha

ghṛtaudanena hutabhukṣomarkau tu guḍaudanaiḥ /
viśvedevāḥ sagandharvā munayo madhupāyasaiḥ

yamamitrau ca sampūjyāvapūpairmodakaistathā /
pitṝnpiśācānuragān sarpiḥkṣīreṇa tarpayet

pakvānena tu māṃsena surāsīthuphalāsavaiḥ /
arcayedbhūtasaṃghāṃśca caṇakaiḥ palalāplutaiḥ

anenaiva vidhānena sampūjyā mattavāraṇī /
pakvāmena tu māṃsena sampūjyā rakṣasāṃ gaṇāḥ

surāmāṃsapradāneana dānavānpratipūjayet /
śeṣāndevagaṇāṃstajjñaḥ sāpūpotkārikaudanaiḥ

matsyaiśca piṣṭabhakṣyaiśca sāgarānsaritastathā /
sampūjya varuṇaṃ cāpi dātavyaṃ ghṛtapāyasam

nānāphūlaphalaścāpi munīnsampratipūjayet /
vāyūṃśca pakṣiṇaścaiva vicitrairbhakṣyabhojanaiḥ

mātṝrnāṭyasya sarvāstā dhanadaṃ ca sahānugaiḥ /
apūpairlājikāmiśrairbhakṣyabhojyaiśca pūjayet

evameṣāṃ baliḥ kāryo nānābhojanasaṃśrayaḥ /
punarmantravidhānena balikarma ca vakṣyate

devadeva mahābhāga sarvalokapitāmaha /
mantrapūtamimaṃ sarvaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva me balim

devadeva mahābhāga gaṇeśa tripurāntaka /
pragṛhyatāṃ balirdeva mantrapūto mayodyataḥ

nārāyaṇāmitagate padmanābha surottama /
pragṛhyatāṃ balirdeva mantrapūto mayārpitaḥ

purandarāmarapate vajrapāṇe śatakrato /
pragṛhyatāṃ balirdeva vidhimantrapuraskṛtaḥ

devasenāpate skanda bhagavan śaṅkarapriya /
baliḥ prītena manasā ṣaṇmukha pratigṛhyatām

mahādeva mahāyogindevadeva surottama /
saṃpragṛhya baliṃ deva rakṣa vighnātsadotthitāt

* devi devamahābhāge sarasvati haripriye /
pragṛhyatāṃ balirmātarmayā bhaktyā samarpitaḥ
rākṣasendrā mahāsatvāḥ pratigṛhṇīta me balim

lakṣmīḥ siddhirmatirmedhā sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ /
mantrapūtamimaṃ devyaḥ pratigṛhṇantu me balim

sarvabhūtānubhāvajña lokajīvana māruta /
pragṛhyatāṃ balirdeva mantrapūto mayodyataḥ

devavaktra suraśreṣṭha dhūmaketo hutāśana /
bhaktyā samudyato deva baliḥ samprati gṛhyatām

sarvagrahāṇāṃ pravara tejorāśe divākara /
bhaktyā mayodyato deva baliḥ samprati gṛhyatām

sarvagrahapate soma dvijarāja jagatpriya /
pragṛhyatāmeṣa balirmantrapūto mayodyataḥ

mahāgaṇeśvarāḥ sarve nandīśvarapurogamāḥ /
pragṛtāṃ balirbhaktyā mayā samprati coditaḥ

namaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pratigṛhṇantvimaṃ balim /
(bhūtebhyaśca namo nityaṃ yeṣāmeṣa baliḥ priyaḥ) /
kāmapāla namo nityaṃ yasyāyaṃ te vidhiḥ kṛtaḥ

nāradastumbaruścaiva viśvāvasupurogamāḥ /
parigṛhṇantu me sarve gandharvā balimudyatam

yamo mitraśca bhagavānīśvarau lokapūjitau /
imaṃ me pratigṛhṇītāṃ baliḥ mantrapuraskṛtam

rasātalagatebhyaśca pannagebhyo namo namaḥ /
diśantu siddhiṃ nāṭyasya pūjitāḥ pāpanāśanāḥ

sarvāmbhasāṃ patirdevo varuṇo haṃsavāhanaḥ /
pūjitaḥ prītamānastu sasamudranadīnadaḥ

vainateya mahāsatva sarvapakṣipate vibho /
pragṛhyatāṃ balirdeva mantrapūto mayodyataḥ

dhanādhyakṣo yakṣapatirlokapālo dhaneśvaraḥ /
saguhyakassayakṣaśca pratigṛhṇātu me balim

namo 'stu nāṭyamātṛbhyo brāhmyādyābhyo namonamaḥ /
sumukhībhiḥ prasannābhirbaliradya pragṛhyatām

rudrapraharaṇaṃ sarvaṃ pratigṛhṇātu me balim /
viṣṇupraharaṇaṃ caiva viṣṇubhaktyā mayodyatam

tathā kṛtāntaḥ kālaśca sarvaprāṇivadheśvarau /
mṛtyuśca niyatiścaiva pratigṛhṇātu me balim

yāścāsyāṃ mattavāraṇyāṃ saṃśritā vastudevatāḥ /
mantrapūtamimaṃ samyakpratigṛhṇantu me balim

anye ye devagandharvā diśo daśa samāśritāḥ /
divyāntarikṣābhaumāśca tebhyaścāyaṃ baliḥ kṛtaḥ

kumbhaṃ salilasampūrṇaṃ puṣpamālāpuraskṛtam /
sthāpayedraṅgamadhye tu suvarṇaṃ cātra dāpayet

ātodyāni tu sarvāṇi kṛtvā vastrottarāṇi tu /
gandhairmālyaiśca dhūpaiśca bhakṣyairbhojyaiśca pūjayet

* pūjayitvā tu sarvāṇi daivatāni yathākramam /
jarjarastvabhisampūjyaḥ syāttato vighnajarjaraḥ

śvetaṃ śirasi vastraṃ syānnīlaṃ raudre ca parvaṇi /
viṣṇuparvaṇi vai pītaṃ raktaṃ skandasya parvaṇi

mṛḍaparvaṇi citraṃ tu deyaṃ vastraṃ hitārthinā /
sadṛśaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ dhūpamālyānulepanam

ātodyāni tu sarvāṇi vāsobhiravaguṇṭhayet /
gandhairmālyaiśca dhūpaiśca bhakṣyabhojaiśca pūjayet

sarvamevaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ /
vighnajarjaraṇārthaṃ tu jarjaraṃ tvabhimantrayet

atra vighnavināśārthaṃ pitāmahamukhaissuraiḥ /
nirmitastvaṃ mahāvīryo vajrasāro mahātanuḥ

śiraste rakṣatu bramhā sarvairdevaguṇaiaḥ taha /
dvitīyaṃ ca haraḥ parva tṛtīyaṃ ca janārdanaḥ

caturthaṃ ca kumāraste pañcamaṃ pannagottamaḥ /
nityaṃ sarve 'pi pāntu tvāṃ surārthe ca śivo bhava

nakṣatre 'bhijiti tvaṃ hi prasūto 'hitasūdana /
jayaṃ cābhyudayaṃ caiva pārthivasya samāvaha

jarjaraṃ pūjayitvaiavaṃ baliṃ sarvaṃ nividya ca /
agnau homaṃ tataḥ kuryānmantrāhuitipuraskṛtam

hutāśa eva dīptābhirulkābhiḥ parimārjanam /
nṛpaternartakīnāṃ ca kuryāddīptyabhivardhanam

abhidyotya sahātodyairnṛpatiṃ nartakīstathā /
mantrapūtena toyena punarabhyukṣya tānvadet

mahākule prasūtāḥ stha guṇaughaiścāpyalaṅkṛtāḥ /
yadvo janmaguṇopetaṃ tadvo bhavatu nityaśaḥ

evamuktvā tato vākyaṃ nṛpatairbhūtaye budhaḥ /
nāṭyayogaprasiddhyarthamāśiṣassamprayojayet

sarasvatī dhṛtirmedhā hrīḥ śrīrlakṣmīssmṛtirmatiḥ /
pāntu vo mātaraḥ saumyāssiddhidāśca bhavantu vaḥ

homaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ havirmantrapuraskṛtam /
bhindyātkumbhaṃ tataścaiva nāṭyācāryaḥ prayatnataḥ

abhinne tu bhavetkumbhe svāminaḥ śatruto bhayam /
bhinne caiva tu vijñeyaḥ svāminaḥ śatrusaṃkṣayaḥ

bhinne kumbhe tataścaiva nāṭyacāryaḥ prayatnataḥ /
pragṛhya dīpikāṃ dīptāṃ sarvaṃ raṅgaṃ pradīpayet

kṣveḍitaiḥ sphoṭitaiścaiva valgitaiśca pradhāvitaiḥ /
raṅgamadhye tu tāṃ dīptāṃ saśabdāṃ samprayojayet

śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣairmṛdaṅgapaṇavaistathā /
sarvātodyaiḥ praṇaditai raṅge yuddhāni kārayet

tatra cchinnaṃ va bhinnaṃ ca dāritaṃ ca saśoṇitam /
kṣataṃ pradīptamāyastaṃ nimittaṃ siddhilakṣaṇam

samyagiṣṭastu raṅgo vai svāminaḥ śubhamāvahet /
purasyābālavṛddhasya tathā jānapadasya ca

duriṣṭastu tathā raṅgo daivatairduradhiṣṭhitaḥ /
nāṭyavidhvasanaṃ kuryānnṛpasya ca tathā'śubham

ya evaṃ vidhimutsṛjya yatheṣṭaṃ samprayojayet /
prāpnotyapacayaṃ śīghraṃ tiryagyoniṃ ca gacchati

yajñena sammitaṃ hyetadraṅgadaivatapūjanam /
apūjayitvā raṅgaṃ tu naiva prekṣāṃ prayojayet

pūjitāḥ pūjayantyete mānitā mānayanti ca /
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ raṅgapūjanam

na tathā pradahatyagniḥ prabhañjanasamīritaḥ /
yathā hyapaprayogastu prayukto dahati kṣaṇāt

śāstrajñena vinītena śucinā dīkṣitena ca /
nāṭyācāryeṇa śāntena kartavyaṃ raṅgapūjanam

sthānabhraṣṭaṃ tu yo dadyādbalimudvignamānasaḥ /
mantrahīno yathā hotā prāyaścittī bhavettu saḥ

ityayaṃ yo vidhirdṛṣṭo raṅgadaivatapūjane /
nave nāṭyagṛhe kāryaḥ prekṣāyāṃ ca prayoktṛbhiḥ

iti bhāratīye nāṭyaśāstre raṅgadaivatapūjanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
atha caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
evaṃ tu pūjanaṃ kṛtvā mayā proktaḥ pitāmahaḥ /
ājñāpaya prabho kṣipraṃ kaḥ prayogaḥ prayujyatām

tato 'smyukto bhagavatā yojayāmṛtamanthanam /
etadutsāhajananaṃ suraprītikaraṃ tathā

yo 'yaṃ samavakārastu dharmakāmārthasādhakaḥ /
mayā prāggrathito vidvansa prayogaḥ prayujyatām

tasminsamavakāre tu prayukte devadānavāḥ /
hṛṣṭāḥ samabhavansarve karmabhāvānudarśanāt
nāṭyaṃ sandarśayāmo 'dya trinetrāya mahātmane

tataḥ sārdhaṃ surairgatvā vṛṣabhāṅkaniveśanam /
samabhyarcya śivaṃ paścāduvācedaṃ pitāmahaḥ

mayā samavākarastu yo 'yaṃ sṛṣṭaḥ surottama /
śravaṇe darśane cāsya prasādaṃ kartumarhasi

paśyāma iti deveśo druhiṇaṃ vākyamabravīt /
tato māmāha bhagavān sajjo bhava mahāmate

tato himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe nānānāgasamākule /
bahubhūtagaṇākīrṇe ramyakandaranirzhare

pūrvaraṅgaḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ tatrāyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ /
tathā tripuradāhaśca ḍimasaṃjñaḥ prayojitaḥ

tato bhūtagaṇā hṛṣṭāḥ karnabhāvānukīrtanāt /
mahādevaśca suprītaḥ pitāmahamathābravīt

aho nāṭyamidaṃ samyak tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ mahāmate /
yaśasyaṃ ca śubhārthaṃ ca puṇyaṃ buddhivivardhanam

mayāpīdaṃ smṛtaṃ nṛtyaṃ sandhyākāleṣu nṛtyatā /
nānākaraṇasaṃyuktairaṅgahārairvibhūṣitam

pūrvaraṅgavidhāvasmiṃstvayā samyakprayojyatām /
vardhamānakayogeṣu gīteṣvāsāriteṣu ca

mahāgīteṣu caivārthānsamyagevābhineṣyasi /
yaścāyaṃ pūrvaraṅgastu tvayā śuddhaḥ prayojitaḥ

ebhirvimiśritaścāyaṃ citro nāma bhaviṣyati /
śrutvā maheśvaravacaḥ pratyuktastu svayaṃbhuvā

prayogamaṅgahārāṇāmācakṣva surasattama /
tatastaṇḍuṃ samāhūya proktavān bhuvaneśvaraḥ

prayogamaṅgahārāṇāmācakṣva bharatāya vai /
tato ye taṇḍunā proktāstvaṅgahārā mahātmanā

tānvaḥ karaṇasaṃyuktānvyākhyāsyāmi sarecakān /
sthirahasto 'ṅgahārastu tathā paryastakaḥ smṛtaḥ

sūcividdhastathā caiva hyapaviddhastathaiva ca /
ākṣiptako 'tha vijñeyastathā coddhaṭṭitaḥ smṛtaḥ

viṣkambhaścaiva samproktastathā caivāparājitaḥ /
viṣkambhāpasṛtaścaiava mattākrīḍastathaiva ca

svastiko recitaścaiva pārśvasvastika eva ca /
vṛścikāpasṛtaḥ prokto bhramaraśca tathāparaḥ

mattaskhalitakaścaiva madādvilasitastathā /
gatimaṇḍalako jñeyaḥ paricchinnastathaiva ca

parivṛttacito 'tha syāttathā vaiśākharecitaḥ /
parāvṛtto 'tha vijñeyastathā caivāpyalātakaḥ

pārśvacchedo 'tha samprokto vidyudbhrāntastathaiva ca /
ūrūdvṛttastathā caiva syādālīḍhastathaiva ca

recitaścāpi vijñeyastathaivācchuritaḥ smṛtaḥ /
ākṣiptarecitaścaiva sambhrāntaśca tathāparaḥ

apasarpastu vijñeyastathā cārdhanikuṭṭakaḥ /
dvātriṃśadete samproktā aṅgahārāstu nāmataḥ

eteṣāṃ tu pravakṣyāmi prayogaṃ karaṇāśrayam /
hastapādapracāraśca yathā yojyaḥ prayoktṛbhiḥ

aṅgahāreṣu vakṣyāmi karaṇeṣu ca vai dvijāḥ /
sarveṣāmaṅgahārāṇāṃ niṣpattiḥ karaṇairyataḥ

tānyataḥ sampravakṣyāmi nāmataḥ karmatastathā /
hastapādasamāyogo nṛtyasya karaṇaṃ bhavet

dve nṛttakaraṇe caiva bhavato nṛttamātṛkā /
dvābhyāṃ tribhiścaturbhirvāpyaṅgahārastu mātṛbhiḥ

tribhiḥ kalāpakaṃ caiva caturbhiḥ ṣaṇḍakaṃ bhavet /
pañcaiva karaṇāni syuḥ saṅghātaka iti smṛtaḥ

ṣaḍbhirvā saptabhirvāpi aṣṭabhirnavabhistathā /
karaṇairiha saṃyuktā aṅgahārāḥ prakīrtāḥ

eteṣāmeva vakṣyāmi hastapādavikalpanam /
talapuṣpapuṭaṃ pūrvaṃ vartitaṃ valitoru ca

apaviddhaṃ samanakhaṃ līnaṃ svastikarecitam /
maṇḍalasvastikaṃ caiva nikuṭṭakamathāpi ca

tathaivārdhanikuṭṭaṃ ca kaṭicchinnaṃ tathaiva ca /
ardharecitakaṃ caiva vakṣaḥsvastikameva ca

unmattaṃ svastikaṃ caiva pṛṣṭhasvastikameva ca /
dikṣvastikamalātaṃ ca tathaiva ca kaṭīsamam

ākṣiptarecitaṃ caiva vikṣiptākṣiptakaṃ tathā /
ardhasvastikamuddiṣṭamañcitaṃ ca tathāparam

bhujaṅgatrāsitaṃ proktamūrdhvajānu tathaiva ca /
nikuñcitaṃ ca mattalli tvardhamattalli caiva hi

syādrecakanikkuṭṭaṃ ca tathā pādāpaviddhakam /
valitaṃ ghūrṇitaṃ caiva lalitaṃ ca tathāparam

daṇḍapakṣaṃ tathā caiva bhujaṅgatrastarecitam /
nūpuraṃ caiva samproktaṃ tathā vaiśākharecitam

bhramaraṃ caturaṃ caiva bhujaṅgāñcitameva ca /
daṇḍarecitakaṃ caiva tathā vṛścikakuṭṭitam

kaṭibhrāntaṃ tathā caiva latāvṛścikameva ca /
chinnaṃ ca karaṇaṃ proktaṃ tathā vṛścikarecitam

vṛścikaṃ vyaṃsitaṃ caiva tathā pārśvanikuṭṭakam /
lalāṭatilakaṃ krāntaṃ kuñcitaṃ cakramaṇḍalam

uromaṇḍalamākṣiptaṃ tathā talavilāsitam /
argalaṃ cātha vikṣiptamāvṛttaṃ dolapādakam

vivṛttaṃ vinivṛttaṃ ca pārśvakrāntaṃ niśumbhitam /
vidyutbhrāntamatikrāntaṃ vivartitakameva ca

gajakrīḍitakaṃ caiva talasaṃsphoṭitaṃ tathā /
garuḍaplutakaṃ caiva gaṇḍasūci tathāparam

parivṛttaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ pārśvajānu tathaiva ca /
gṛdhrāvalīnakaṃ caiva sannataṃ sūcyathāpi ca

ardhasūcīti karaṇaṃ sūcividdhaṃ tathaiva ca /
apakrāntaṃ ca samproktaṃ mayūralalitaṃ tathā

sarpitaṃ daṇḍapādaṃ ca hariṇaplutameva ca /
preṅkholitaṃ nitambaṃ ca skhalitaṃ karihastakam

prasarpitakamuddiṣṭaṃ siṃhavikrīḍataṃ tathā /
siṃhākarṣitamudvṛttaṃ tathopasṛtameva ca

talasaṃghaṭṭitaṃ caiva janitaṃ cāvahitthakam /
niveśamelakākrīḍamūrūdvṛttaṃ tathaiva ca

madaskhalitakaṃ caiva viṣṇukrāntamathāpi ca /
sambhrāntamatha viṣkambhamudghaṭṭitamathāpi ca

vṛṣabhakrīḍitaṃ caiva lolitaṃ ca tathāparam /
nāgāpasarpitaṃ caiva śakaṭāsyaṃ tathaiva ca

gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ caivetyuktamaṣṭādhikaṃ śatam /
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hyetatkaraṇānāṃ mayoditam

nṛtye yuddhe niyuddhe ca tatha gatiparikrame /
gatipracāre vakṣyāmi yuddhacārīvikalpanam

yatra tatrāpi saṃyojyamācāryairnāṭyaśaktinaḥ /
prāyeṇa karaṇe kāryo vāmo vakṣaḥsthitaḥ karaḥ

caraṇasyānugaścāpi dakṣiṇastu bhavetkaraḥ /
hastapādapracārantu kaṭipārśvorusaṃyutam

uraḥpṛṣṭhodaropetaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ nibodhata /
yāni sthānāni yāścāryo nṛtyahastāstathaiva ca

sā mātṛketi vijñeyā tadyogātkaraṇaṃ bhavet /
kaṭī karṇasamā yatra korparāṃsaśirastathā

samunnatamuraścaiva sauṣṭhavaṃ nāma tadbhavet /
vāme puṣpapuṭaḥ pārśve pādo 'gratalasañcaraḥ

tathā ca sannataṃ pārśvaṃ talapuṣpapuṭaṃ bhavet /
kuñcitau maṇibandhe tu vyāvṛttaparivartitau

hastau nipatitau corvorvartitaṃ karaṇaṃ tu tat /
śukatuṇḍau yadā hastau vyāvṛttaparivartitau

urū ca valitau yasminvalitorukamucyate /
āvartya śukatuṇḍākhyamūrupṛṣṭhe nipātayet

vāmahataśca vakṣaḥstho 'pyapaviddhaṃ tu tadbhavet /
śliṣṭau samanakhau padau karau cāpi pralimbitau

dehaḥ svābhāviko yatra bhavetsamanakhaṃ tu tat /
patākāñjali vakṣaḥsthaṃ prasāritaśirodharam

nihañcitāṃsakūṭaṃ ca tallinaṃ karaṇaṃ smṛtam /
svastikau recitāviddhau viśliṣṭau kaṭisaṃśritau

yatra tatkaraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ budhaiḥ svastikarecitam /
svastikau tu karau kṛtvā prāṅgamukhordhvatalau samau

tathā ca maṇḍalaṃ sthānaṃ maṇḍalasvastikaṃ tu tat /
nikuṭṭitau yadā hastau svabāhuśiraso 'ntare

pādau nikuṭṭitau caiva jñeyaṃ tattu nikuṭṭakam /
añcitau bāhuśirasi hastastvabhimukhāṅguliḥ

nikuñcitārdhayogena bhavedarthanikuṭṭakam /
paryāyaśaḥ kaṭiśchinnā bāhvoḥ śirasi pallavau

punaḥpunaśca karaṇaṃ kaṭicchinaṃ tu tadbhavet /
apaviddhakaraḥ sūcyā pādaścaiva nikuṭṭitaḥ

saṃnnataṃ yatra pārśvaṃ ca tadbhaveardharecitam /
svastikau caraṇau yatra karau vakṣasi recitau

nikuñcitaṃ tathā vakṣo vakṣassvastikameva tat /
āñcitena tu pādena recitau tu karau yadā

unmataṃ karaṇaṃ tattu vijñeyaṃ nṛtyakovidaiḥ /
hastābhyāmatha pādābhyāṃ bhavataḥ svastikau yadā

tatsvastikamiti proktaṃ karaṇaṃ karaṇārthibhiḥ /
vikṣiptākṣiptabāhubhyāṃ svastikau caraṇau yadā

apakrāntārdhasūcibhyāṃ tatpṛṣṭhasvastikaṃ bhavet /
pārśvayoragrataścaiva yatra śliṣṭaḥ karo bhavet

svastikau hastapādābhyāṃ taddikṣvastikamucyate /
alātaṃ caraṇaṃ kṛtvā vyaṃsayeddakṣiṇaṃ karam

ūrdhvajānukramaṃ kuryādalātakamiti smṛtam /
svastikāpasṛtaḥ pādaḥ karau nābhikaṭisthitau

pārśvamudvāhitaṃ caiva karaṇaṃ tatkaṭīsamam /
hastau hṛdi bhavedvāmaḥ savyaścākṣiptarecitaḥ

recitaścāpaviddhaśca tatsyādākṣiptarecitam /
vikṣiptaṃ hastapādaṃ ca tasaivākṣepaṇaṃ punaḥ

yatra tatkaraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ vikṣiptākṣiptaptakaṃ dvijāḥ /
svastikau caraṇau kṛtvā karihastaṃ ca dakṣiṇam

vakṣasthāne tathā vāmamardhasvastikamādiśet /
vyāvṛttaparivṛttastu sa eva tu karo yadā

añcito nāsikāgre tu tadañcitamudāhṛtam /
kuñcitaṃ pādamutkṣipya tryaśramūruṃ vivartayet

kaṭijānuvivartācca bhujaṅgatrāsitaṃ bhavet /
kuñcitaṃ pādamutkṣipya janustanasamaṃ nyaset

prayogavaśagau hastāvūrdhvajānu prakīrtitam /
vṛścikaṃ caraṇaṃ kṛtvā karaṃ pārśve nikuñcayet

nāsāgre dakṣiṇaṃ caiva jñeyaṃ tattu nikuñcitam /
vāmadakṣiṇapādābhyāṃ ghūrṇamānopasarpaṇaiḥ

udveṣṭitāpaviddhaiśca hastairmattallyudāhṛtam /
sskhalitāpasṛtau pādau vāmahastaśca recitaḥ

savyahastaḥ kaṭisthaḥ syādardhamattalli tatsmṛtam /
recito dakṣiṇo hastaḥ pādaḥ savyo nikuṭṭitaḥ

dolā caiva bhavedvāmastadrecitanikuṭṭitam /
kāryau nābhitaṭe hastau prāṅmukhau khaṭakāmukhau

sūcīviddhāvapakrāntau pādau pādāpaviddhake /
apaviddho bhaveddhastaḥ sūcīpādastathaiava ca

tathā trikaṃ vivṛttaṃ ca valitaṃ nāma tadbhavet /
vartitāghūrṇitaḥ savyo hasto vāmaśca dolitaḥ

svastikāpasṛtaḥ pādaḥ karaṇaṃ ghūrṇitaṃ tu tat /
karihasto bhavedvāmo dakṣiṇaśca vivartitaḥ

bahuśaḥ kuṭṭitaḥ pado jñeyaṃ tallalitaṃ budhaiḥ /
ūrdhvajānuṃ vidhāyātha tasyopari latāṃ nyaset

daṇḍpakṣaṃ tatproktaṃ karṇaṃ nṛtyavedibhiḥ /
bhujañgatrāsitaṃ kṛtvā yatrobhāvapi recitau

vāmapārśvasthtau hastau bhujaṅgatrastarecitam /
trikaṃ suvalitaṃ kṛtvā latārecitakau karau

nūpurśca tathā pādaḥ karaṇE nūpure nyaset /
recitau hastapādau ca kaṭī grīvā ca recitā

vaiśākhasthānakenaitadbhavevaiśākharecitam /
ākṣiptaḥ svastikaḥ pādaḥ karau codveṣṭitau tathā

trikasya valanāccaiva jñeyaṃ bhramarakaṃ tu tat /
añcitaḥ syātkaro vāmaḥ savyaścatura eva tu

dakṣiṇaḥ kuṭṭitaḥ pādaścaturaṃ tatprakīrtitam /
bhujaṅgatrāsitaḥ pādo dakṣiṇo recitaḥ karaḥ

latākhyaśca karo vāmo bhujaṅgāñcitakaṃ bhavet /
vikṣiptaṃ hastapādaṃ tu samantādyatra daṇḍavat

recyate taddhi karaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ daṇḍakarecitam /
vṛścikaṃ caraṇaṃ kṛtvā dvāvapyatha nikuṭṭitau

vidhātavyau karau tattu jñeyaṃ vṛścikakuṭṭitam /
sūciṃ kṛtvāpaviddhaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ caraṇaṃ nyaset

recitā ca kaṭiryatra kaṭibhrāntaṃ taducyate /
añcitaḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ pādaḥ kuñcitordhvatalāṅguliḥ

latākhyaśca karo vāmastallatāvṛścikaṃ bhavet /
alapadmaḥ kaṭīdeśe chinnā paryāyaśaḥ kaṭī

vaiśākhasthānakeneha tacchinnaṃ karaṇaṃ bhavet /
vṛścikaṃ caraṇaṃ kṛtvā svastikau ca karavubhau

recitau viprakīrṇau ca karau vṛścikarecitam /
bāhuśīrṣāñcitau hastau pādaḥ pṛṣṭhāñcitastathā

dūrasannatapṛṣṭhaṃ ca vṛścikaṃ tatprakīrtitam /
ālīḍhaṃ sthānakaṃ yatra karau vakṣasi recitau

ūrdhvādho viprakīrṇau ca vyaṃsitaṃ karaṇaṃ tu tat /
hastau tu svastikau pārśve tathā pādo nikuṭṭitaḥ

yatra tatkaraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ budhaiḥ pārśvanikuṭṭitam /
vṛścikaṃ caraṇaṃ kṛtvā pādasyāṅguṣṭhakena tu

lalāṭe tilakaṃ kuryāllalāṭatilakaṃ tu tat /
pṛṣṭhataḥ kuñcitaṃ kṛtvā vyatikrāntakramaṃ tataḥ

ākṣiptau ca karau kāryau krāntake karaṇe dvijāḥ /
ādyaḥ pādo nataḥ kāryaḥ savyahastaśca kuñcitaḥ

uttāno vāmapārśvasthastatkuñcitamudāhṛtam /
pralambitābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ yadgātreṇānatena ca

abhyantarāpaviddhaḥ syāttajjñeyaṃ cakramaṇḍalam /
svastikāpasṛtau pādāvapaviddhakramau yadā

uromaṇḍalakau hastāvuromaṇḍalikastu tat /
ākṣiptaṃ hastapādaṃ ca kriyate yatra vegataḥ

ākṣiotaṃ nāma karaṇaṃ vijñeyaṃ tatdvijottamāḥ /
ūrdhvāṅgulitalaḥ pādaḥ pārśvenordhvaṃ prasāritaḥ

prakuryādañcitatalau hastau talavilāsite /
pṛṣṭhataḥ prasṛtaḥ pādau dvau tālāvardhameva ca

tasyeva cānugo hastaḥ puratastvargalaṃ tu tat /
vikṣiptaṃ hastapādaṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvato 'pi vā

ekamārgagataṃ yatra tadvikṣiptamudāhṛtam /
prasārya kuñcitaṃ pādaṃ punarāvartayet drutam

prayogavaśagau hastau tadāvartamudāhṛtam /
kuñcitaṃ pādamutkṣipya pārśvātpārśvaṃ tu ḍolayet

prayogavaśagau hastau ḍolāpādaṃ taducyate /
ākṣiptaṃ hastapādaṃ ca trikaṃ caiva vivartayet

recitau ca tathā hastau vivṛtte karaṇe dvijāḥ /
sūcīviddhaṃ vidhāyātha trikaṃ tu vinivartayet

karau ca recitau kāryau vinivṛtte dvijottamaḥ /
pārśvakrāntakramaṃ kṛtvā purastādatha pātayet

prayogavaśagau hastau pārśvakrāntaṃ taducyate /
pṛṣṭhataḥ kuñcitaḥ pādau vakṣaścaiva samunnatam

tilake ca karaḥ sthāpyastannistambhitamucyate /
pṛṣṭhato valitaṃ pādaṃ śiroghṛṣṭaṃ prasārayet

sarvato maṇḍalāviddhaṃ vidyudbhrāntaṃ taducyate /
atikrāntakramaṃ kṛtvā purastātsaṃprasārayet

prayogavaśagau hastāvatikrānte prakīrtitau /
ākṣiptaṃ hastapādaṃ ca trikaṃ caiva vivartitam

dvitīyo recito hasto vivartitakameva tat /
karṇe 'ñcitaḥ karo vāmo latāhastaśca dakṣiṇaḥ

dolāpādastathā caiva gajakrīḍitakaṃ bhavet /
drutamutkṣipya caraṇaṃ purastādatha pātayet

talasaṃsphoṭitau hastau talasaṃsphoṭite matau /
pṛṣṭhaprasāritaḥ pādaḥ latārecitakau karau

samunnataṃ śiraścaiva garuḍaplutakaṃ bhavet /
sūcipādo nataṃ pārśvameko vakṣaḥsthitaḥ karaḥ

dvitīyaścāñcito gaṇḍe gaṇḍasūcī taducyate /
ūrdhvāpaveṣṭitau hastau sūcīpādo vivartitaḥ

parivṛttatrikaṃ caiva parivṛttaṃ taducyate /
ekaḥ samasthitaḥ pāda ūrupṛṣṭhe sthito 'paraḥ

muṣṭihastaśca vakṣaḥsthaḥ pārśvajānu taducyate /
pṛṣṭhaprasāritaḥ pādaḥ kiñcitañcita jānukaḥ

yatra prasārito bāhū tatsyāt gṛdhrāvalīnakam /
utplutya caraṇau kāryāvagrataḥ svastikasthitau

sannatau ca tathā hastau sannataṃ tadudāhṛtam /
kuñcitaṃ pādamutkṣipya kuryādagrasthitaṃ bhuvi

prayogavaśagau hastau sā sūcī parikīrtitā /
alapadmaḥ śirohastaḥ sūcīpādaśca dakṣiṇaḥ

yatra tatkaraṇaṃ jñeayamardhasūcīti nāmataḥ /
pādasūcyā yadā pādo dvitīyastu pravidhyate

kaṭivakṣaḥsthitau hastau sūcīvidhaṃ taducyate /
kṛtvoruvalitaṃ pādamapakrāntakramaṃ nyaset

prayogavaśagau hastavapakrāntaṃ taducyate /
vṛścikaṃ caraṇaṃ kṛtvā recitau ca tathā karau

tathā trikaṃ vivṛttaṃ ca mayūralalitaṃ bhavet /
añcitāpasṛtau pādau śiraśca parivāhitam

recitau ca tathā hastau tatsarpitamudāhṛtam /
nūpuraṃ caraṇaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍapādaṃ prasārayet

kṣiprāviddhakaraṃ caiva daṇḍapādaṃ taducyate /
atikrāntakramaṃ kṛtvā samutplutya nipātayet

jaṅghāñcitopari kṣiptā tadvidyāddhariṇaplutam /

ḍolāpādakramaṃ kṛtvā samutplutya nipātayet

parivṛttatrikaṃ caiva tatpreṅkholitamucyate /
bhujāvūrdhvaviniṣkrāntau hastau cābhimukhāṅgulī

baddhā cārī tatha caiva nitambe karaṇe bhavet /
dolāpādakramaṃ kṛtvā hastau tadanugāvubhaua

recitau ghūrṇitau vāpi skhalitaṃ karaṇaṃ bhavet /
eko vakṣaḥsthito hastaḥ prodveṣṭitatalo 'paraḥ

añcitaścaraṇaścaiva prayojyaḥ karihastake /
ekastu recito hasto latākhyastu tathā paraḥ

prasarpitatalau pādau prasarpitakameva tat /
alātaṃ ca puraḥkṛtvā dvitīyaṃ ca drutakramam

hastau pādānugau cāpi siṃhavikrīḍite smṛtau /
pṛṣṭhaprasarpitaḥ pādastathā hastau nikuñcitau

punastathaiva kartavyau siṃhākarṣtake dvijāḥ /
ākṣiptahastamākṣiptadehamākṣiptapādakam

advṛttagātramityetadudvṛtāṃ karaṇaṃ smṛtam /
ākṣiptacaraṇaścaiko hastau tasyaiva cānugau
dolāpādakramaṃ kṛtvā talasaṅghaṭṭitau karau

recayecca karaṃ vāmaṃ talasaṅghaṭṭite sadā /
eko vakṣaḥsthito hasto dvtīyaśca pralambitaḥ

talāgrasaṃsthitaḥ pādo janite karaṇe bhavet /
janitaṃ karaṇaṃ kṛtvā hastau cābhimukhāṅgulī

śanairnipatito caiva jñeyaṃ tadavahitthakam /
karau vakṣaḥsthitau kāryāvurau nirbhugnameva ca

maṇḍalasthānakaṃ caiva niveśaṃ karaṇaṃ tu tat /
talasañcarapādābhyāmutplutya patanaṃ bhavet

saṃnataṃ valitaṃ gātramelakākrīḍitaṃ tu tat /
karamāvṛttakaraṇamūrupṛṣṭhe 'ñcitaṃ nyaset

jaṅghāñcitā tathodvṛttā hyūrūdvṛttaṃ tu tadbhavet /
karau pralambitau kāryo śiraśca parivāhitam

pādau ca valitāvidhdaua madaskhalitake dvijāḥ /
puraḥ prasāritaḥ pādaḥ kuñcito gaganonmukhaḥ

karau ca recitau yatra viṣṇukrāntaṃ taducyate /
karamāvartitaṃ kṛtvā hyūrupṛṣṭhe nikuñcayet

ūruścaiva tathāviddhaḥ sambhrāntaṃ karaṇaṃ tu tat /
apaviddhaḥ karaḥ sūcyā pādaścaiva nikuṭṭitaḥ

vakṣaḥsthaśca karo vāmo viṣkambhe karaṇe bhavet /
pādāvuddhaṭṭitau kāryau talasaṅghaṭṭitau karau

nataśca pārśvaṃ kartavyaṃ budhairuddhaṭṭite sadā /
prayujyālātakaṃ pūrvaṃ hastau cāpi hi recayet

kuñcitāvañcitau caiva vṛṣabhakrīḍite sadā /
recitāvañcitau hastau lolitaṃ vartitaṃ śiraḥ

ubhayoḥpārśvayoryatra tallolitamudāhṛtam /
svastikāpasṛtau pādau śiraśca parivāhitam

recitau ca tathā hastau syātāṃ nāgāpasarpite /
niṣaṇṇāṅgastu caraṇaṃ prasārya talasañcaram

udvāhitamuraḥ kṛtvā śakaṭāsyaṃ prayojayet /
ūrdhvāṅgulitalau pādau tripatākāvadhomukhau

hastau śirassannataṃ ca gaṅgāvataraṇaṃ tviti /
yāni sthānāni yāścāryo vyāyāme kathitāni tu

pādapracārastveṣāṃ tu karaṇānāmayaṃ bhavet /
ye cāpi nṛttahastāstu gaditā nṛttakarmaṇi

teṣāṃ samāsato yogaḥ karaṇeṣu vibhāvyate /
prāyeṇa karaṇe kāryo vāmo vakṣaḥsthitaḥ karaḥ

caraṇaścānugaścāpi dakṣiṇastu bhavetkaraḥ /
cāryaścaiva tu yāḥ proktā nṛttahastāstathaiva ca

sā mātṛketi vijñeyā tadbhedātkaraṇāni tu /
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hyetatkaraṇānāṃ mayoditam

ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi hyaṅgahāravikalpanam /
prasāryotkṣipya ca karau samapādaṃ prayojayet

vyaṃsitāpasṛtaṃ savyaṃ hastamūrdhvaṃ prasārayet /
pratyālīḍhaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tathaiva ca nikuṭṭakam

ūrūdvṛttaṃ tataḥ kuryādakṣiptaṃ svastikaṃ tataḥ /
nitambaṃ kari hastaṃ ca kaṭicchinnaṃ ca yogataḥ

sthirahasto bhavedeṣa tvaṅgahāro harapriyaḥ /
talapuṣpāpaviddhe dve vartitaṃ saṃnikuṭṭikam

ūrūdvṛttaṃ tathākṣiptamuromaṇḍalameva ca /
nitambaṃ karihastaṃ ca kaṭicchinnaṃ tathaiva ca

eṣa paryastako nāma hyaṅgahāro harodbhavaḥ /
alapallavasūcīṃ ca kṛtvā vikṣiptameva ca

āvartitaṃ tataḥ kuryāttathaiava ca nikuṭṭakam /
ūrūdvṛttaṃ tathākṣiptamuromaṇḍalameva ca

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ sūcīviddho bhavedayam /
apaviddhaṃ tu karaṇaṃ sūcīviddhaṃ tathaiva ca

udveṣṭitena hastena trikaṃ tu parivartayet /
uromaṇḍalakau hastau kaṭicchinnaṃ tathaiva ca

apaviddho 'ṅgahārāśca vijñeyo 'yaṃ prayoktṛbhiḥ /
karaṇaṃ nūpuraṃ kṛtvā vikṣiptālātake punaḥ

punarākṣiptakaṃ kuryāduromaṇḍalakaṃ tathā /
nitambaṃ karihastaṃ ca kaṭicchinnaṃ tathaiva ca

ākṣiptakaḥ sa vijñeyo hyaṅgahāraḥ prayoktṛbhiḥ /
udveṣṭitāpaviddhastu karaḥ pādo nikuṭṭitaḥ

punastainaiva yogena vāmapārśve bhavedatha /
uromaṇḍalakau hastau nitambaṃ karihastakam

kartavyaṃ sakaṭicchinnaṃ nṛtye tūddhaṭṭite sadā /
paryāyodveṣṭitau hastau pādau caiva nikuṭṭitau

kuñcitāvañcitaua caiva hyūrūdvṛttaṃ tathaiva ca /
caturaśraṃ karaṃ kṛtvā pādena ca nikuṭṭakam

bhujaṅgatrāsitaṃ caiva karaṃ codviṣṭitaṃ punaḥ /
paricchinnaṃ ca kartavyaṃ trikaṃ bhramarakeṇa tu

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ viṣkambhe parikīrtitam /
daṇḍapādaṃ karaṃ caiva vikṣipyākṣipya caiva hi

vyaṃsitaṃ vāmahastaṃ ca saha pādena sarpayet /
nikuṭṭakadvayaṃ kāryamākṣiptaṃ maṇḍalorasi

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ kartavyamaparājite /
kuṭṭitaṃ karaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhujaṅgatrāsitaṃ tathā

recitena tu hastena patākaṃ hastamādiśet /
ākṣiptakaṃ prayuñjīta hyuromaṇḍalakaṃ tathā

latākhyaṃ sakaṭakacchinnaṃ viṣkambhāpasṛte bhavet /
trikaṃ suvalitaṃ kṛtvā nūpuraṃ karaṇaṃ tathā

bhujaṅgatrāsitaṃ savyaṃ tathā vaiśākharecitam /
ākṣiptakaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paricchinnaṃ tathaiva ca

bāhyabhramarakaṃ kuryāduromaṇḍalameva ca /
nitambaṃ karihastaṃ ca kaṭicchinnaṃ tathaiva ca

mattākrīḍo bhavedeṣa hyaṅgahāro harapriyaḥ /
recitaṃ hastapādaṃ ca kṛtvā vṛścikameva ca

punastenaiva yogena vṛścikaṃ samprayojayet /
nikuṭṭakaṃ tathā caiva savyāsavyakṛtaṃ kramāt

latākhyaḥ sakaṭicchedo bhavetsvastikarecite /
pārśve tu svastikaṃ baddhvā kāryaṃ tvatha nikuṭṭakam

dvitīyasya ca pārśvasya vidhiḥ syādyameva hi /
tataśca karamāvartya hyūrūpṛṣṭhe nipātayet

ūrūdvṛttaṃ tataḥ kuryādākṣiptaṃ punareva hi /
nitambaṃ karihastaṃ ca kaṭicchinnaṃ tathaiva ca

pārśvasvastika ityeṣa hyaṅgahāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ /
vṛścikaṃ karaṇaṃ kṛtvā latākhyaṃ hastameva ca

tameva ca karaṃ bhūyo nāsāgre sannikuñcayet /
tamevodveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā nitambaṃ parivartayet

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ vṛścikāpasṛte bhavet /
kṛtvā nūpurapādaṃ tu tathākṣiptakameva ca

paricchinnaṃ ca kartavyaṃ sūcīpādaṃ tathaiva ca /
nitambaṃ karihastaṃ cāpyuromaṇḍalakaṃ tathā

kaṭīcchinnaṃ tataścaiva bhramaraḥ sa tu saṃjñitaḥ /
matallikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā karamāvartya dakṣiṇam
apaviddhaṃ drutaṃ caiva talasaṃsphoṭasaṃyutam

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ mattaskhalitake bhavet /
dolaiḥ karaiḥ pracalitaiḥ svastikāpasṛtaiḥ padaiḥ

añcitairvalitairhastaistalasaṅghaṭṭitaistathā /
nikuṭṭitaṃ ca kartavyamūrūdvṛtaṃ tathaiva ca

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ madādvilasite bhavet /
maṇḍalaṃ sthānakaṃ kṛtvā tathā hastau ca recitau

udghaṭṭitena pādena mattallikaraṇaṃ bhavet /
ākṣiptaṃ karaṇaṃ caiva hyuromaṇḍalameva ca

kaṭicchinnaṃ tathā caiva bhavettu gatimaṇḍale /
samapādaṃ prayujyātha paricchinnaṃ tvanantaram

āviddhena tu pādena bāhyabhramarakaṃ tathā /
vāmasūcyā tvatikrāntaṃ bhujaṅgatrāsitaṃ tathā

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ paricchinne vidhīyate /
śirasastūpari sthāpyau svastiakau vicyutau karau

tataḥ savyaṃ karaṃ cāpi gātramānamya recayet /
punarutthāpayettatra gātramunnamya recitam

latākhyau ca karau kṛtvā vṛścikaṃ samprayojayet /
recitaṃ karihastaṃ ca bhujaṅgatrāsitaṃ tathā

ākṣiptakaṃ prayuñjīta svastikaṃ pādameva ca /
parāṅgmukhavidhirbhūya evameva bhavediha

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ parivṛttakarecitee /
recitau saha gātreṇa hyapaviddhau karau yadā

punastenaiva deśena gātramunnamya recayet /
kuryānnūpurapādaṃ ca bhujaṅgatrāsitaṃ tathā

recitaṃ maṇḍalaṃ caiva bāhuśīrṣe nikuñcayet /
ūrūdvṛttaṃ tathākṣiptamuromaṇḍalameva ca

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ kuryādvaiśākharecite /
ādyaṃ tu janitaṃ kṛtvā pādamekaṃ prasārayet

tathaivālātakaṃ kuryāt trikaṃ tu parivartayet /
añcitaṃ vāmahastaṃ ca gaṇḍadeśe nikuṭṭayet

kaṭicchinnaṃ tathā caiva parāvṛtte prayojayet /
svastikaṃ karaṇaṃ kṛtvā vyaṃsitau ca karau punaḥ

alātakaṃ prayuñjīta hyūrdhvajānu nikuñcitam /
ardhasūcī ca vikṣiptamudvṛttākṣiptake tathā

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnamaṅgahāre hyalātake /
nikuṭya vakṣasi karāvūrdhvajānu prayojayet

ākṣiptasvastikaṃ kṛtvā trikaṃ tu parivartayet /
uromaṇḍalakau hastau nitambaṃ karihastakam

kaṭicchinnaṃ tathā caiva pārśvacchede vidhīyate /
sūcīvāmapadaṃ dadhyādvidyudbhrāntaṃ ca dakṣiṇam

dakṣiṇena punaḥ sūcī vidyudbhrāntaṃ ca vāmataḥ /
paricchinnaṃ tathā caiva hyatikrāntaṃ ca vāmakam

latākhyaṃ sakaṭicchinnaṃ vidyudbhrāntaśca sa smṛtaḥ /
kṛtvā nūpurapādaṃ tu savyavāmau pralambitau

karau pārśve tatastābhyāṃ vikṣiptaṃ samprayojayet /
tābhyāṃ sūcī tathā caiva trikaṃ tu parivartayet

latākhyaṃ sakaṭicchinnaṃ kurtādudvṛttake sadā /
ālīḍhavyaṃsitau hastau bāhuśīrṣe nikuṭṭayet

nūpuraścaraṇo vāmastathālātaśca dakṣiṇaḥ /
tenaivākṣiptakaṃ kuryāduromaṇḍalakau karau

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnamālīḍhe samprayojayet /
hastaṃ tu recitaṃ kṛtvā pārśvamānasya recayet

punastenaiva yogena gātramānasya recayet /
recitaṃ karaṇaṃ kāryamuromaṇḍalameva ca

kaṭicchinnaṃ tu kartavyamaṅgahāre tu recite /
nūpuraṃ caraṇaṃ kṛtvā trikaṃ tu parivartayet

vyaṃsitena tu hastena trikameva vivartayet /
vāmaṃ cālātakaṃ kṛtvā sūcīmatraiva yojayet

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ kuryādācchurite sadā /
recitau svastikau pādau recitau svastikau karau

kṛtvā viśleṣamevaṃ tu tenaiva vidhinā punaḥ /
punarutkṣepaṇaṃ caiva recitaireva kārayet

udvṛttākṣiptake caiva hyuromaṇḍalameva ca /
nitambaṃ karihastaṃ ca kaṭicchinnaṃ tathaiva ca

ākṣiptarecito hyeṣa karaṇānāṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
vikṣipta karaṇaṃ kṛtvā hastapādaṃ mukhāgamam

vāmasūcisahakṛtaṃ vikṣipedvāmakaṃ karam /
vakṣaḥsthāne bhavetsavyo valitaṃ trikameva ca

nūpurākṣiptake caiva hyardhasvastikameva ca /
nitambaṃ karihastaṃ ca hyuromaṇḍalakaṃ tathā

kaṭicchinnaṃ ca kartavyaṃ sambhrānte nṛttayoktṛbhiḥ /
apakrāntakramaṃ kṛtvā vyaṃsitaṃ hastameva ca

kuryādudveṣṭitaṃ caiva hyardhasūcīṃ tathaiva ca /
vikṣiptaṃ sakaṭicchinnamudvṛttākṣiptake tathā

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ kartavyamapasarpite /
kṛtvā nūpurapādaṃ ca drutamākṣipya ca kramam

pādasya cānugau hastau trikaṃ ca parivartayet /
nikuṭya karapādaṃ cāpyuromaṇḍalakaṃ punaḥ

karihastaṃ kaṭicchinnaṃ kāryamardhanikuṭṭake /
dvātriṃśadete samproktā hyaṅgahārā dvijottamāḥ

caturo recakāṃścāpi gadato me nibodhata /
pādarecaka ekaḥ syāt dvitīyaḥ kaṭirecakaḥ

kararecakastṛtīyastu caturthaḥ kaṇṭharecakaḥ /
[recitākhyaḥ pṛthagbhāve valane cābhidhīyate /
udvāhanātpṛthagbhāvāccalanāccāpi recakaḥ

ab*1 pārśvātpārśve tu gamanaṃ skhalitaiścalitaiḥ padaiḥ /
vividhaiścaiva pādasya pādarecaka ucyate

ab*2 trikasyodvartanaṃ caiva chaṭīvalanameva ca /
tathā'pasarpaṇaṃ caiva kaṭirecaka ucyate

ab*3 udvartanaṃ parikṣepo vikṣepaḥ parivartanam /
visarpaṇaṃ ca hastasya hastarecaka ucyate

ab*4 udvāhanaṃ sannamanaṃ tathā pārśvasya sannatiḥ /
bhramaṇaṃ cāpi vijñeyo grīvāyā recako budhaiḥ]
ab*5 recakairaṅgahāraiśca nṛtyantaṃ vīkṣya śaṅkaram

sukumāraprayogeṇa nṛtyantīṃ caiva pārvatīm /
mṛdañgabherīpaṭahairbhāṇḍaḍiṇḍimagomukhaiḥ

paṇavairdaduraiścaiva sarvātodyaiḥ pravāditaiḥ /
dakṣayajñe vinihate sandhyākāle maheśvaraḥ

nānāṅgahāraiḥ prānṛtyallayatālavaśānugaiaḥ /
piṇḍibandhāṃstato dṛṣṭvā nandibhadramukhā gaṇāḥ

cakruste nāma piṇḍīnāṃ bandhamāsāṃ salakṣaṇam /
īśvarasyeśvarī pinḍī nandinaścāpi paṭṭasī

caṇḍikāyā bhavetpiṇḍī tathā vai siṃhavāhinī /
tārkṣyapiṇḍī bhavedviṣṇoḥ padmapiṇḍī svayaṃbhuvaḥ

śakrasyairāvatī piṇḍī jhaṣapiṇḍī tu mānmathī /
śikhipiṇḍī kumārasya rūpapiṇḍī bhavecchriyaḥ

dhārāpiṇḍī ca jāhnavyāḥ pāśapiṇḍī yamasya ca /
vāruṇī ca nadīpiṇḍī yākṣī syāddhanadasya tu

halapiṇḍī balasyāpi sarpapiṇḍī tu bhoginām /
gāṇeśvarī mahāpiṇḍī dakṣayajñavimardinī

triśūlākṛtisaṃsthānā raudrī syādandhakadviṣaḥ /
evamanyāsvapi tathā devatāsu yathākramam

dhvajabhūtāḥ prayoktavyāḥ piṇḍībandhāḥ sucihnitāḥ /
recakā aṅgahārāśca piṇḍībandhātasthaiva ca

sṛṣṭvā bhagavatā dattāstaṇḍave munaye tadā /
tenāpi hi tataḥ samyaggānabhāṇḍasamanvitaḥ

nṛttaprayogaḥ sṛṣṭo yaḥ sa tāṇḍava iti smṛtaḥ /
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ -
yadā prāptyarthamarthānāṃ tajjñairabhinayaḥ kṛtaḥ

kasmānṛttaṃ kṛtaṃ hyetatkaṃ svabhāvamapekṣate /
na gītakārthasambaddhaṃ na cāpyarthasya bhāvakam

kasmānnṛttaṃ kṛtaṃ hyetadgīteṣvāsāriteṣu ca /
bharataḥ -
atrocyate na khalvarthaṃ kañcinnṛttamapekṣate

kiṃ tu śobhāṃ prajanayediti nṛttaṃ pravartitam /
prāyeṇa sarvalokasya nṛttamiṣṭaṃ svabhāvataḥ

maṅgalamiti kṛtvā ca nṛttametatprakīrtitam /
vivāhaprasavāvāhapramodābhyuadayādiṣu

vinodakāraṇaṃ ceti nṛttametatpravartitam /
ataścaiva pratikṣepādbhūtasaṅghaiḥ pravartitāḥ

ye gītakādau yujyante samyaṅnṛttavibhāgakāḥ /
devena cāpi samproktastaṇḍustāṇḍavapūrvakam

gītaprayogamāśritya nṛttametatpravartyatām /
prāyeṇa tāṇḍavavidhirdevastutyāśrayo bhavet

sukumāraprayogaśca śṛṅgārarasasambhavaḥ /
tasya taṇḍuprayuktasya tāṇḍavasya vidhikriyām

vardhamānakamāsādya sampravakṣyami lakṣaṇam /
kalānāṃ vṛddhimāsādya hyakṣarāṇāṃ ca vardhanāt

layasya vardhanāccāpi vardhamānakamucyate /
kṛttvā kutapavinyāsaṃ yathāvaddvijasattamāḥ

āsāritaprayogastu tataḥ kāryaḥ prayoktṛbhiḥ /
tatra tūpohanaṃ kṛttvā tantrīgānasamanvitam

kāryaḥ praveśo nartakyā bhāṇḍavādyasamanvitaḥ /
viśuddhakaraṇāyāṃ tu jātyāṃ vādyaṃ prayojayet

gatyā vādyānusāriṇyā tasyāścārīṃ prayojayet /
vaiśākhasthānakeneha sarvarecakacāriṇī

puṣpāñjalidharā bhūtvā praviśedraṅgamaṇḍapam /
puṣpāñjaliṃ visṛjyātha raṅgapīṭhaṃ parītya ca

praṇamya devatābhyaśca tato 'bhinayamācaret /
yatrābhineyaṃ gītaṃ syāttatra vādyaṃ na yojayet

aṅgahāraprayoge tu bhāṇḍavādyaṃ vidhīyate /
samaṃ raktaṃ vibhaktaṃ ca sphuṭaṃ śuddhaprahārajam

nṛttāṅgagrāhi vādyajñairvādyaṃ yojyaṃ tu tāṇḍave /
prayujya gītavādye tu niṣkrāmennartakī tataḥ

anenaiva vidhānena praviśantyaparāḥ pṛthak /
anyāścānukrameṇātha piṇḍīṃ badhnanti yāḥ striyaḥ

tāvatparyastakaḥ kāryo yāvatpiṇḍī na badhyate /
piṇḍīṃ baddhvā tataḥ sarvā niṣkrāmeyuḥ striyastu tāḥ

piṇḍībandheṣu vādyaṃ tu kartavyamiha vādakaiaḥ /
paryastakapramāṇena citraughakaraṇānvitam

tatropavāhanaṃ bhūyaḥ kāryaṃ pūrvavadeva hi /
tataścāsāritaṃ bhūyo gāyanaṃ tu prayojayet

pūrveṇaiva vidhānena praviśeccāpi nartakī /
gītakārthaṃ tvabhinayed dvitīyāsāritasya tu

tadeva ca punarvastu nṛttenāpi pradarśayet /
āsārite samāpte tu niṣkrāmennartakī tataḥ

pūrvavatpraviśantyanyāḥ prayogaḥ syātsa eva hi /
evaṃ pade pade kāryo vidhirāsāritasya tu

bhāṇḍavādyakṛte caiva tathā gānakṛte 'pi ca /
ekā tu prathamaṃ yojyā dve dvitīyaṃ tathaiva ca

tisro vastu tṛtīyaṃ tu catasrastu caturthakam /
piṇḍīnāṃ vidhayaścaiva catvāraḥ samprakīrtitāḥ

piṇḍī śṛṅkhalikā caiva latābandho 'tha bhedyakaḥ /
piṇḍībandhastu piṇḍatvādgulmaḥ śṛṅkhalikā bhavet

jālopanaddhā ca latā sanṛtto bhedyakaḥ smṛtaḥ /
piṇḍībandhaḥ kaniṣṭhe tu śṛṅkhalā tu layāntare

madhyame ca latābandho jyeṣṭhe caivātha bhedyakaḥ /
piṇḍīnāṃ vividhā yoniryantraṃ bhadrāsanaṃ tathā

śikṣāyogastathā caiva prayoktavyaḥ prayoktṛbhiḥ /
evaṃ prayogaḥ kartavyo vardhamāne tapodhanāḥ

gītānāṃ chandakānāṃ ca bhūyo vakṣyāmyahaṃ vidhim /
yāni vastunibaddhāni yāni cāṅgikṛtāni tu

gītāni teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi prayogaṃ nṛttavādyayoḥ /
tatrāvataraṇaṃ kāryaṃ nartakyāḥ sārvabhāṇḍikam

kṣepapratikṣepakṛtaṃ bhāṇḍopohanasaṃskṛtam /
prathamaṃ tvabhineyaṃ syadgītake sarvavastukam

tadeva ca punarvastu nṛtteenāpi pradarśeyat /
yo vidhiḥ pūrvamuktastu nṛttābhinayavādite

āsāritavidhau sa syādgītānāṃ vastukeṣvapi /
evaṃ vastunibandhānāṃ gītakānāṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ

śṛṇutāṅganibaddhānāṃ gītānāmapi lakṣaṇam /
ya eva vastukavidhirnṛttābhinayavādite

tamevāṅganibaddheṣu cchandakeṣvapi yojayet /
vādyaṃ gurvakṣarakṛtaṃ tathālpākṣarameva ca

mukhe sopohane kuryādvarṇānāṃ viprakarṣataḥ /
yadā gītivaśādaṅgaṃ bhūyo bhūyo nivartate

tatrādyamabhineyaṃ syāccheṣaṃ nṛttena yojayet /
yadā gītivaśādaṅgaṃ bhūyo bhūyo nivartate

tripāṇilayasaṃyuktaṃ tatra vādyaṃ prayojayet /
yathā layastathā vādyaṃ kartavyamiha vādakaiḥ

[tataṃ cānugataṃ cāpi oghaṃ ca karaṇānvitam /
sthire tattvaṃ prayoktavyaṃ madhye cānugataṃ bhavet

tajjñeyaṃ sukumāraṃ hi śṛṅgārarasasambhavam

yasyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ nṛttaṃ yojyaṃ prayoktṛbhiḥ /
tatsarvaṃṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tacca me śṛṇuta dvijāḥ

aṅgavastunivṛttau tu tathā varṇanivṛttiṣu /
tathā cābhudayasthāne nṛttaṃ tajjñaḥ prayojayet

yattu saṃdṛśyate kiñciddampatyormadanāśrayam /
nṛttaṃ tatra prayoktavyaṃ praharṣārthaguṇodbhavam

yatra sannihite kānte ṛtukālādidarśanam /
gītakārthābhisaṃbaddhaṃ nṛttaṃ tatrāpi ceṣyate

khaṇḍiatā vipralabdhā vā kalahāntaritāpi vā /
yasminnaṅge tu yuvatirna nṛttaṃ tatra na yojayet

sakhīpravṛtte saṃlāpe tathā'sannihite priye /
na hi nṛttaṃ prayoktavyaṃ yasyā na proṣitaḥ priyaḥ

[dūtyāśrayaṃ yadā tu syādṛtukālādi darśanam /
autsukyacintāsaṃbaddhaṃ na nṛttaṃ tatra yojayet]

* yasminnaṅge prasādaṃ tu gṛhnīyānnāyikā kramāt /
tataḥprabhṛti nṛttaṃ tu śeṣeṣvaṅgeṣu yojayet

devastutyāśrayakṛtaṃ yadaṅgaṃ tu bhavedatha /
māheśvarairaṅgahārairuddhataistatprayojayet

yattu śṛṅgārasaṃbaddhaṃ gānaṃ strīpuruṣāśrayam /
devīkṛtairaṅgahārairlalitaistatprayojayet

catuṣpadā narkuṭake khañjake parigītake /
vidhānaṃ sampravakṣyāmi bhāṇḍavādyavidhiṃ prati

khañjanarkuṭasaṃyuktā bhasvedyā tu catuṣpadā /
pādānte sannipāte tu tasyā bhāṇḍagraho bhavet

yā dhruvā chandasā yaktā samapādā samākṣarā /
tasyāḥ pādāvasāne tu pradeśinyā graho bhavet

kṛtvaikaṃ parivartaṃ tu gānasyābhinayasya ca /
punaḥ pādanivṛttiṃ tu bhāṇḍavādyena yojayet

a~ṅgavastunivṛtau tu varṇāntaranivṛttiṣu /
tathopasthāpane caiva bhāṇḍavādyaṃ prayojayet

ye 'pi cāntaramārgāssyuḥ tantrivākkaraṇaiḥ kṛtāḥ /
teṣu sūcī prayoktavyā bhāṇḍena saha tāṇḍave
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā śivalokaṃ sa gacchati

evameṣa vidhiḥ sṛ(rdṛ)ṣṭastāṇḍavasya prayogataḥ /
bhūyaḥ kiṃ kathyatāmanyannāṭyavedavidhiṃ prati

iti bhāratīye nāṭyaśāstre tāṇḍavalakṣaṇaṃ nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ
atha pūrvaraṅgavidhāno nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā nāṭyasantānakāraṇam /
punarevābruvanvākyamṛṣayo hṛṣṭamānasāḥ

yathā nāṭyasya janmedaṃ jarjarasya ca sambhavaḥ /
vighnānāṃ śamanaṃ caiva daivatānāṃ ca pūjanam

tadasmābhiḥ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhītvā cāvadhāritam /
nikhilena yathātattvamicchāmo vedituṃ punaḥ

pūrvaraṅgaṃ mahātejaḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam /
yathā buddhyāmahe brahmaṃstathā vyākhyātumarhasi

teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā munīnāṃ bharato muniḥ /
pratyuvāca punarvākyaṃ pūrvaraṅgavidhiṃ prati

pūrvaraṅgaṃ mahābhāgā gadato me nibodhata /
pādabhāgāḥ kalāścaiva parivartāstathaiva ca

yasmādraṅge prayogo 'yaṃ pūrvameva prayujyate /
tasmādayaṃ pūrvaraṅgo vijñeyo dvijasattamāḥ

asyāṅgāni tu kāryāṇi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ /
tantrībhāṇḍasamāyoagaiḥ pāṭhyayogakṛtaistathā

pratyāhāro 'vataraṇaṃ tathā hyārambha eva ca /
āśrāvaṇā vaktrapāṇistathā ca parighaṭṭanā

saṅghoṭanā tataḥ kāryā mārgāsāritameva ca /
jyeṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhāni tathaivāsāratāni ca

etāni tu bahirgītānyantaryavanikāgataiḥ /
prayoktṛbhiḥ prayojyāni tantrībhāṇḍakṛtāni ca

tataḥ sarvaistu kutapaiḥ saṃyuktānīha kārayet /
vighaṭya vai yavanikāṃ nṛttapāṭhyakṛtāni tu

gītānāṃ madrakādīnāṃ yojyamekaṃ tu gītakam /
vardhamānamathāpīha tāṇḍavaṃ yatra yujyate

tataścotthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ parivartanameva ca /
nāndī śuṣkāvakṛṣṭā ca raṅgadvāraṃ tathaiva ca

cāri caiva tataḥ kāryā mahācārī tathaiva ca /
trikaṃ prarocanāṃ cāpi pūrvaraṅge bhavanti hi

etānyaṅgāni kāryāṇi pūrvaraṅgavidhau dvijāḥ /
eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇamahaṃ vyākhyāsyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ

kutapasya tu vinyāsaḥ pratyāhāra iti smṛtaḥ /
tathāvataraṇaṃ proktaṃ gāyikānāṃ niveśanam

parigītakriyārambha ārambha iti kīrtitaḥ /
ātodyarañjanārthaṃ tu bhavedāśrāvaṇāvidhiḥ

vādyavṛttivibhāgārthaṃ vaktrapāṇirvidhīyate /
tantryojaḥkaraṇārthaṃ tu bhavecca parighaṭṭanā

tathā pāṇivibhāgārthaṃ bhavetsaṃghoṭanāvidhiḥ /
tantrībhāṇḍasamāyogānmārgāsāritamiṣyate

kalāpātavibhāgārthaṃ bhavedāsāritakriyā /
kīrtanāddevatānāṃ ca jñeyo gītavidhistathā
[ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyami hyutthāpanavidhikriyām]

* yasmādutthāpayantyatra prayogaṃ nāndipāṭhakāḥ /
pūrvameva tu raṅge 'smiṃstasmādutthāpanaṃ smṛtam

yasmācca lokapālānāṃ parivṛtya caturdiśam /
vandanāni prakurvanti tasmācca parivartanam

āśīrvacanasaṃyuktā nityaṃ yasmātprayujyate /
devadvijanṛpādīnāṃ tasmānnāndīti saṃjñitā

atra śuṣkākṣaraireva hyavakṛṣṭā dhruvā yataḥ /
tasmācchuṣkāvakṛṣṭeyaṃ jarjaraślokadarśitā

yasmādabhinayastvatra prathamaṃ hyavatāryate /
raṅgadvāramato jñeyaṃ vāgaṅgābhinayātmakam

śṛṅgārasya pracaraṇāccārī samparikīrtitā /
raudrapracaraṇāccāpi mahācārīti kīrtitā

vidūṣakaḥ sūtradhārastathā vai pāripārśvakaḥ /
yatra kurvanti sañjalpaṃ taccāpi trigataṃ matam

upakṣepeṇa kāvyasya hetuyuktisamāśrayā /
siddhenāmantraṇā yā tu vijñeyā sa prarocanā

ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi hyāśrāvaṇavidhikriyām /
bahirgītavidhau samyagutpattiṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā

citradakṣiṇavṛtau tu saptarūpe pravartite /
sopohane sanirgīte devastutyabhinandite

nāradādyaistu gandharvaiḥ sabhāyāṃ devadānavāḥ /
nirgītaṃ śrāvitāḥ samyaglayatālasamanvitam
abhavankṣubhitāḥ sarve mātsaryāddaityarākṣasāḥ

sampradhārya ca te 'nyonyamityavocannavasthitāḥ /
nirgītaṃ tu savāditramidaṃ gṛhṇīmahe vayam

saptarūpeṇa santuṣṭā devāḥ karmānukīrtanāt /
vayaṃ gṛhṇīma nirgītaṃ tuṣyāmo 'traiva sarvadā

te tatra tuṣṭā daityāstu sādhayanti punaḥ punaḥ /
ruṣṭāścāpi tato devāḥ pratyabhāṣanta nāradam

ete tuṣyanti nirgīte dānavā saha rākṣasaiḥ /
praṇaśyatu prayogo 'yaṃ kathaṃ vā manyate bhavān

devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā nārado vākyamabravīt /
dhātuvādyāśrayakṛtaṃ nirgītaṃ mā praṇaśyatu

kintūpohanasaṃyuktaṃ dhātuvādyavibhūṣitam /
bhaviṣyatīdaṃ nirgītaṃ saptarūpavidhānataḥ

nirgītenāvabaddhāśca daityadānavarākṣasāḥ /
na kṣobhaṃ na vighātaṃ ca kariṣyantīha toṣitāḥ

evaṃ nirgītametattu daityānāṃ spardhayā dvijāḥ /
devānāṃ bahumānena bahirgītamiti smṛtam

dhātubhiścitravīṇāyāṃ gurulaghvakṣarānvitam /
varṇālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ prayoktavyaṃ budhairatha

nirgītaṃ geyate yasmādapadaṃ varṇayojanāt /
asūyayā ca devānāṃ bahirgītamidaṃ smṛtam

nirgītaṃ yanmayā proktaṃ saptarūpasamanvitam /
utthāpanādikaṃ yacca tasya kāraṇamucyate

āśrāvaṇāyāṃ yuktāyāṃ daityāstuṣyanti nityaśaḥ /
vaktrapāṇau kṛte caiva nityaṃ tuṣyanti dānavāḥ

parighaṭṭanayā tuṣṭā yuktāyāṃ rākṣasāṃ gaṇāḥ /
saṅghoṭanakriyāyāṃ ca tuṣyantyapi ca guhyakāḥ

mārgāsāritamāsādya tuṣṭā yakṣā bhavanti hi /
gītakeṣu prayukteṣu devāstuṣyanti nityaśaḥ

vardhamāne prayukte tu rudrastuṣyati sānugaḥ /
tathā cotthāpane yukte brahmā tuṣṭo bhavediha

tuṣyanti lokapālāśca prayukte parivartane /
nāndīprayoge 'tha kṛte prīto bhavati candramāḥ

yuktāyāmavakṛṣṭāyāṃ prītā nāgā bhavanti hi /
tathā śuṣkāvakṛṣṭāyāṃ prītaḥ pitṛgaṇo bhavet

raṅgadvāre prayukte tu viṣṇuḥ prīto bhavediha /
jarjarasya prayoge tu tuṣṭā vighnavināyakāḥ

tathā cāryā prayuktāyāmumā tuṣṭā bhavediha /
mahācāryā prayuktāyāṃ tuṣṭo bhūtagaṇo bhavet

āśrāvaṇādicāryantametaddaivatapūjanam /
pūrvaraṅge mayā khyātaṃ tathā cāṅgavikalpanam

devastuṣyanti yo yena yasya yanmanasaḥ priyam /
tattathā pūrvaraṅge tu mayā prokaṃ dvijottamāḥ

sarvadaivatapūjārhaṃ sarvadaivatapūjanam /
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ pūrvaraṅgapravartanam

daityadānavatuṣṭyarthaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām /
nirgītāni sagītāni pūrvaraṅgakṛtāni tu

[yā vidyā yāni śilpāni yā gatiryaśca ceṣṭitam /
lokālokasya jagatastadasminnāṭakāśraye]

* nirgītānāṃ sagītānāṃ vardhamānasya caiva hi /
dhruvāvidhāne vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇaṃ karma caiva hi

prayujya gītakavidhiṃ vardhamānamathāpi ca /
gītakānte tataścāpi kāryā hyutthāpanī dhruvā

adau dve ca caturthaṃ cāpyaṣṭamaikādaśe tathā /
gurvakṣarāṇi jānīyatpāde hyekādaśe tathā

catuṣpadā bhavetsā tu caturaśrā tathaiva ca /
caturbhissannipātaiśca trilayā triyatistathā

parivartāśca catvāraḥ pāṇayastraya eva ca /
jātyā caiva hi viślokā tāṃ ca tālena yojayet

śamyā tu dvikalā kāryā talo dvikala eva ca /
punaścaikakalā śamyā sannipātaḥ kalātrayam

evamaṣṭakalaḥ kāryaḥ sannipāto viacakṣaṇaiḥ /
catvāraḥ sannipātāśca parivartaḥ sa ucyate

pūrvaṃ sthitalayaḥ kāryaḥ parivarto vicakṣaṇaiḥ /
tṛtīye sannipāte tu tasyā bhāṇḍagraho bhavet

ekasminparivarte tu gate prāpte dvitīyake /
kāryaṃ madhyalaye tajjñaiḥ sūtradhārapraveśanam

puṣpāñjaliṃ samādāya rakṣāmaṅgalasaṃskṛtāḥ /
śuddhavastrāḥ sumanasastathā cādbhutadṛṣṭayaḥ

sthānantu vaiṣṇavaṃ kṛtvā sauṣṭhavāṅgapuraskṛtam /
dīkṣitāḥ śucayaścaiva praviśeyuḥ samaṃ trayaḥ

bhṛṅgārajarjaradharau bhavetāṃ pāripārśvikau /
madhye tu sūtrabhṛttābhyāṃ vṛttaḥ pañcapadīṃ vrajet

padāni pañca gaccheyurbrahmaṇo yajanecchayā /
padānāñcāpi vikṣepaṃ vyākhyāsyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ
pārśvotthānotthitaṃ caiva tanmadhye pātayetpunaḥ

evaṃ pañcapadīṃ gatvā sūtradhāraḥ sahetaraḥ /
sūcīṃ vāmapade dadyādvikṣepaṃ dakṣiṇena ca

puṣpāñjalyapavargaśca kāryo brāhme 'tha maṇḍale /
raṅgapīṭhasya madhye tu svayaṃ brahmā pratiṣṭhitaḥ

tataḥ salalitairhastairabhivandya pitāmaham /
abhivādāni kāryāṇi trīṇi hastena bhūtale

kālaprakarṣahetośca pādānāṃ pravibhāgataḥ /
sūtradhārapraveśādyo vandanābhinayāntakaḥ

dvitīyaḥ parivartastu kāryo madhyalayāśritaḥ /
tataḥ paraṃ tṛtīye tu maṇḍalasya pradakṣiṇam

bhavedācamanaṃ caiva jarjaragrahaṇaṃ tathā /
utthāya maṇḍalāttūrṇaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pādamuddharet

vedhaṃ tenaiva kurvīta vikṣepaṃ vāmakena ca /
punaśca dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ pārśvasaṃsthaṃ samuddharet

tataśca vāmavedhastu vikṣepo dakṣiṇasya ca /
ityanena vidhānena samyakkṛtvā pradikṣaṇam

bhṛṅgārabhṛtamāhūya śaucaṃ cāpi samācaret /
yathānyāyaṃ tu kartavyā tena hyācamanakriyā

ātmaprokṣaṇamevādbhiḥ kartavyaṃ tu yathākramam /
prayatnakṛtaśaucena sūtradhāreṇa yatnataḥ

sannipātasamaṃ grāhyo jarjaro vighnajarjaraḥ /
pradakṣiṇādyo vijñeyo jarjaragrahaṇāntakaḥ

tṛtīyaḥ parivartastu vijñeyo vai drute laye /
gṛhītvā jarjaraṃ tvaṣṭau kalā japyaṃ prayojayet

vāmavedhaṃ tataḥ kuryādvikṣepaṃ dakṣiṇasya ca /
tataḥ pañcapadīṃ caiva gacchettu kutaponmukhaḥ

vāmavedhastu tatrāpi vikṣepo dakṣiṇasya tu /
jarjaragrahaṇādyo 'yaṃ kutapābhimukhāntakaḥ

caturthaḥ parivartastu kāryo drutalaye punaḥ /
karapādanipātāstu bhavntyatra tu ṣoḍaśa

tryaśre dvādaśa pātāstu bhavanti karapādayoḥ /
vandanānyatha kāryāṇi trīṇi hastena bhūtale

ātmaprokṣaṇamadbhiśca tryaśre naiva vidhīyate /
evamutthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ tatastu parivartanam

caturaśraṃ laye madhye sannipātairathāṣṭabhiḥ /
yasyā laghūni sarvāṇi kevalaṃ naidhanaṃ guru

bhavedatijagatyāntu sā dhruvā parivartanī /
vārtikena tu mārgeṇa vādyenānugatena ca

lalitaiḥ pādavinyāsairvandyā devā yathādiśam /
dvikalaṃ pādapatanaṃ pādacāryā gataṃ bhavet

vāmapādena vedhastu kartavyo nṛttayoktṛbhiḥ /
dvitālāntaraviṣkambho vikṣepo dakṣiṇasya ca

tataḥ pañcapadīṃ gacchedatikrāntaiḥ padaratha /
tato 'bhivādanaṃ kuryāddevatānāṃ yathādiśam

vandeta prathamaṃ pūrvāṃ diśaṃ śakrādhidaivatām /
dvitīyāṃ dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ vandeta yamadevatām

vandeta paścimāmāśāṃ tato varuṇadaivatām /
caturthīmuttarāmāśāṃ vandeta dhanadāśrayām

diśāṃ tu vandanaṃ kṛtvā vāmavedhaṃ prayojayet /
dakṣiṇena ca kartavyaṃ vikṣepaparivartanam

prāṅgmukhastu tataḥ kuryātpuruṣastrīnapuṃsakaiḥ /
tripadyā sūtrabhṛdrudrabrahmopendrābhivādanam

dakṣiṇaṃ tu padaṃ puṃso vāmaṃ strīṇāṃ prakīrtitam /
punardakṣiṇameva syānnātyutkṣiptaṃ napuṃsakam

vandeta pauruṣeṇeśaṃ strīpadena janārdanam /
napuṃsakpadenāpi tathaivāmbujasambhavam

parivartanamevaṃ syāttasyānte praviśettataḥ /
caturthakāraḥ puṣpāṇi pragṛhya vidhipūrvakam

yathāvattena kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ jarjarasya tu /
kutapasya ca sarvasya sūtradhārasya caiva hi

tasya bhāṇḍasamaḥ kāryastajjñairgatiparikramaḥ /
na tatra gānaṃ kartavyaṃ tatra stobhakriyā bhavet

caturthakāraḥ pūjāṃ tu sa kṛtvāntarhito bhavet /
tato geyāvakṛṣṭā tu caturaśrā sthitā dhruvā

guruprāyā tu sā kāryā tathā caivāvapāṇikā /
sthāyivarṇāśrayopetā kalāṣṭakavinirmitā

[caturthaṃ pañcamaṃ caiva saptamaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ tathā /
laghūni pāde paṅktyāntu sāvakṛṣṭā dhruvā smṛtā]

* sūtradhāraḥ paṭhettatra madhyamaṃ svaramāśritaḥ /
nāndīṃ padairdvādaśabhiraṣṭabhirvā'pyalaṅkṛtām

namo 'stu sarvadevebhyo dvijātibhyaḥ śubhaṃ tathā /
jitaṃ somena vai rājñā śivaṃ gobrāhmaṇāya ca

brahmottaraṃ tathaivāstu hatā brahmadviṣastathā /
praśāstvimāṃ mahārājaḥ pṛthivīṃ ca sasāgarām

rāṣṭraṃ pravardhatāṃ caiva raṅgasyāśā samṛddhyatu /
prekṣākarturmahāndharmo bhavatu brahmabhāṣitaḥ

kāvyakarturyaśaścāstu dharmaścāpi pravardhatām /
ijyayā cānayā nityaṃ prīyantāṃ devatā iti

nāndīpadāntareṣveṣu hyevamāryeti nityaśaḥ /
vadetāṃ samyaguktābhirvāgbhistau pāripārśvikau

evaṃ nāndī vidhātavyā yathāvallakṣaṇānvitā /
tataśśuṣkāvakṛṣṭā syājjarjaraślokadarśikā

navaṃ gurvākṣarāṇyādau ṣaḍlaghūni gurutrayam /
śuṣkāvakṛṣṭā tu bhavetkalā hyaṣṭau pramāṇataḥ

yathā:
digle digle digle digle jambukapalitakate tecām /
kṛtvā śuṣkāvakṛṣṭāṃ tu yathāvaddvijasattamāḥ

tataḥ ślokaṃ paṭhedekaṃ gambhīrasvarasaṃyutam /
devastotraṃ puraskṛtya yasya pūjā pravartate

rājño vā yatra bhaktiḥ syādatha vā brahmaṇasstavam /
gaditvā jarjaraślokaṃ raṅgadvāre ca yatsmṛtam

paṭhedanyaṃ punaḥ ślokaṃ jarjarasya vināśanam /
jarjaraṃ namayitvā tu tataścārīṃ prayojayet

pāripārśvikayośca syātpaścimenāpasarpaṇam /
aṅkitā cātra kartavyā dhruvā madhyalayānvitā

caturbhiḥ sannipātaiśca caturaśrā pramāṇataḥ /
ādyamantyaṃ caturthaṃ ca pañcamaṃ ca tathā guru

yasyāṃ hrasvāni śeṣāṇi sā jñeyā tvaṅkitā budhaiḥ /
asyāḥ prayogaṃ vakṣyāmi yathā pūrvaṃ maheśvaraḥ

sahomayā krīḍitavānnānābhāvaviceṣṭataiḥ /
kṛtvā'vahitthaṃ sthānaṃ tu vāmaṃ cādhomukhaṃ bhujam

caturaśramuraḥ kāryamañcitaścāpi mastakaḥ /
nābhipradeśe vinyasya jarjaraṃ ca tulādhṛtam

vāmapallavahastena pādaistālāntarotthitaiḥ /
gacchetpañcapadīṃ caiva savilāsāṅgaceṣṭitaiḥ

vāmavedhastu kartavyo vikṣepo dakṣiṇasya ca /
śṛṅgārarasasaṃyuktāṃ paṭhedāryāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ

cārīślokaṃ gaditvā tu kṛtvā ca parivartanam /
taireva ca padaḥ kāryaṃ paścimenāpasarpaṇam

pāripārśvikahaste tu nyasya jarjaramuttamam /
mahācārīṃ tataścaiva prayuñjīta yathāvidhi

caturaśrā dhruvā tatra tathā drutalayānvitā /
caturbhissannipātaiśca kalā hyaṣṭau pramāṇataḥ

ādyaṃ caturthamantyaṃ ca saptamaṃ daśamaṃ guru /
laghu śeṣaṃ dhruvāpāde caturviṃśatike bhavet

(yathā-)
pādatalāhatipātitaśailaṃ kṣobhitabhūtasamagrasamudram /
tāṇḍavanṛtyamidaṃ pralayānte pātu jagatsukhadāyi harasya

bhāṇḍonmukhena kartavyaṃ pādavikṣepaṇaṃ tataḥ /
sūcīṃ kṛtvā punaḥ kuryādvikṣepaparivartanam

atikrāntaiḥ salalitaiḥ pādairdrutalayānvitaiḥ /
tritālāntaramutkṣepairgacchetpañcapadīṃ tataḥ

tatrāpi vāmavedhastu vikṣepo dakṣiṇasya ca /
taireva ca padaiḥ kāryaṃ prāṅmukhenāpasarpaṇam

punaḥ padāni trīṇyeva gacchetprāṅmukha eva tu /
tataśca vāmavedhaḥ syādvikṣepo dakṣiṇasya ca

tato raudrarasaṃ ślokaṃ pādasaṃharaṇaṃ paṭhet /
tasyānte tu tripadyātha vyāharetpāripārśvikau

tayorāgamane kāryaṃ gānaṃ narkuṭakaṃ budhaiḥ /
tathā ca bhāratībhede trigataṃ samprayojayet

vidūṣakastvekapadāṃ sutradhārasmitāvahām /
asambaddhakathāprāyāṃ kuryātkathanikā tataḥ

(vitaṇḍāṃ gaṇḍasaṃyuktāṃ tālikāñca prayojayet /
kastiṣṭhati jitaṃ kenetyādikāvyaprarūpiṇīm

*1 pāripārśvakasañjalpo vidūṣakavirūpitaḥ /
sthāpitaḥ sūtradhāreṇa trigataṃ samprayujyate)

*2 prarocanā ca kartavyā siddhenopanimatraṇam /
raṅgasiddhau punaḥ kāryaṃ kāvyavastunirūpaṇam

sarvameva vidhiṃ kṛtvā sūcīvedhakṛtairatha /
pādairanāviddhagatairniṣkrāmeyuḥ samaṃ trayaḥ

evameṣa prayoktavyaḥ pūrvaraṅgo yathāvidhi /
caturaśro dvijaśreṣṭhāstryaśraṃ cāpi nibodhata

ayameva prayogaḥ syādaṅgānyetāni caiva hi /
tālapramāṇaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ kevalaṃ tu viśeṣakṛt

śamyā tu dvikalā kāryā tālo hyekakalastathā /
punaścaikakalā śamyā sannipātaḥ kalādvayam

anena hi pramāṇena kalātālalayānvitaḥ /
kartavyaḥ pūrvaraṅgastu tryaśro 'pyutthāpanādikaḥ

ādyaṃ caturthaṃ daśamamaṣṭamaṃ naidhanaṃ guru /
yasyāstu jāgate pāde sā tryaśrotthāpinī dhruvā

vādyaṃ gatipracāraśca dhruvā tālastathaiva ca /
saṃkṣiptānyeva kāryāṇi tryaśre nṛttapravedibhiḥ

vādyagītapramāṇena kuryādaṅgaviceṣṭitam /
vistīrṇamatha saṃkṣiptaṃ dvipramāṇavinirmitam

hastapādapracārastu dvikalaḥ parikīrtitaḥ /
caturaśre parikrānte pātāḥ syuḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu

tryaśre dvādaśa pātāstu bhavanti karapādayoḥ /
etatpramāṇaṃ vijñeyamubhayoḥ pūrvaraṅgayoḥ

kevalaṃ parivarte tu gamane tripadī bhavet /
digvandane pañcapadī caturaśre vidhīyate

ācāryabuddhyā kartavyastryaśrastālapramāṇataḥ /
tasmānna lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ punaruktaṃ bhavedyataḥ

evameṣa prayoktavyaḥ pūrvaraṅgo dvijottamāḥ /
tryaśraśca caturaśraśca śuddho bhāratyupāśrayaḥ

evaṃ tāvadayaṃ śuddhaḥ pūrvaraṅgo mayoditaḥ /
